title_translated: 研究统一多模态模型中的图像分词器作为视觉语言
summary_translated: 图像分词器定义了统一多模态模型的‘视觉语言’，但通常仅通过孤立的指标或仅生成/理解的评估来研究。这些评估未能充分捕捉视觉标记在与文本联合建模时的行为。我们构建了一个受控的纯自回归测试平台，并在跨文本、图像、文本到图像（T2I）和图像到文本（I2T）预测的多模态持续预训练过程中跟踪特定任务的验证损失。我们考察了这些损失的缩放特性及其与下游性能的关系，进而利用它们研究多模态可学习性——即图像和文本标记联合建模的程度以及分词器设计。我们发现：（1）损失应按任务分析，因为它们表现出不同的缩放行为并可能对分词器排名不同；（2）损失与性能的关系取决于预测的标记空间：对于固定分词器，T2I和I2T损失与生成质量相关，但跨分词器时，T2I损失-性能关系随图像标记空间变化，而I2T损失基于共享文本词汇表，提供更一致的信号。I2T损失在监督微调后也与生成和视觉理解性能相关。通过损失视角，我们还发现：（3）更好的重建并不必然带来更低的任务特定损失或更强的下游性能；（4）图像分词器的选择会影响联合优化下的文本建模。作为案例研究，我们重新审视三个分词器设计维度——判别器、语义监督和词汇量大小——以考察其对联合建模和下游性能的影响。总体而言，我们的测试平台为图像分词器作为视觉语言提供了互补视角，突显了其在联合多模态训练中与文本的相互作用。

summary: Robotic Process Automation (RPA) is widely used to reduce administrative burden in United States hospitals, yet an estimated 30-50% of RPA initiatives underperform because processes are selected informally, without a repeatable method to catalogue candidates, prioritize them, match each to an automation tier -- a Python bot, an open-source orchestrator such as n8n, or an enterprise platform such as UiPath -- and forecast financial return before committing resources. We propose a four-module, data-driven framework unifying these decisions: a Process Taxonomy of twenty recurring hospital processes across five value streams; a Prioritization module deriving an Automation Suitability Index from an Analytic Hierarchy Process matrix with an explicit consistency check; a Tool-Tier Selection module recommending the least-cost technology sufficient for a process complexity, integration, and compliance profile; and a Return-on-Investment module quantifying labor savings, error-cost avoidance, payback, and net present value. Applied to a synthetic portfolio spanning all twenty processes, plus a reference data-flow architecture linking it to hospital EHR/payer/ERP systems: 12 of 20 clear the prioritization threshold; the ranking is robust to +/-20% weight perturbation (Spearman correlation 0.83, top-5 set preserved 97.7%, 2,000 Monte Carlo trials); an Automation Risk Index flags four qualifying processes as Critical risk; a budget-constrained portfolio optimization shows diminishing marginal NPV as spend scales from $400K to $1.03M; and a second Monte Carlo analysis shows portfolio NPV stays positive at its 5th percentile. The framework is a conceptual synthesis of the literature rather than an instrument calibrated on primary hospital data; we discuss HIPAA governance and a research agenda for empirical validation. A supplementary Python implementation accompanies the paper.
title: A Data-Driven Framework for Identifying and Prioritizing RPA Opportunities in Healthcare Processes
comment: 21 pages, 2 figures, 14 tables
title_translated: 一种数据驱动框架用于识别和优先处理医疗流程中的RPA机会
summary_translated: 机器人流程自动化（RPA）被广泛用于减轻美国医院的行政负担，但估计有30%-50%的RPA项目表现不佳，原因是流程选择缺乏正式方法，没有可重复的方法来记录候选流程、优先排序、匹配每个流程到合适的自动化层级（如Python机器人、开源编排工具n8n，或企业级平台UiPath），并在投入资源前预测财务回报。我们提出一个四模块数据驱动框架，整合这些决策：涵盖五个价值流中二十个常见医院流程的流程分类体系；一个优先级模块，基于层次分析法矩阵并包含显式一致性检查，推导出自动化适用性指数；一个工具-层级选择模块，推荐满足流程复杂度、集成和合规性要求的最低成本技术；一个投资回报率模块，量化人力节省、错误成本避免、回收期和净现值。应用于涵盖全部二十个流程的合成组合，以及连接至医院电子病历/支付方/ERP系统的参考数据流架构：20个中有12个通过优先级阈值；排名在±20%权重扰动下稳健（Spearman相关系数0.83，前5名集合保留率97.7%，2000次蒙特卡洛试验）；自动化风险指数标记四个符合条件的流程为高风险；预算约束的组合优化显示，支出从40万美元增至103万美元时，边际NPV递减；第二次蒙特卡洛分析表明，组合NPV在第5百分位仍保持正值。该框架是文献概念性综合，而非基于原始医院数据校准的工具；我们讨论了HIPAA治理及实证验证的研究议程。附带的Python实现可随论文获取。

summary: Existing methods for test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) derive rewards from answer-level self-voting on unlabeled test-time tasks with canonical answers, but this breaks down for code generation because programs cannot be compared by surface form and therefore do not directly provide a usable training signal. To make TTRL applicable to code generation, we propose probe-driven TTRL, which constructs output-free probe inputs from the problem statement, executes candidate programs on these probes, and defines a Probe Consensus Reward (PCR) from the resulting behavioral agreement. PCR provides a behavioral training signal for open-vocabulary programs, but it is not a fully reliable verifier and remains susceptible to reward hacking through spurious consensus. We therefore introduce Entropy-Regularized Rank-Masked Policy Optimization (ERPO), which converts low PCR into conservative negative updates through rank masking and controls policy drift with an entropy ceiling. On coding benchmarks, ERPO substantially improves pass@1 and pass@k in both in-domain adaptation and zero-shot transfer.
title: Entropy-Regularized Rank-Masked Policy Optimization for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning in Code Generation
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 15 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables
title_translated: 用于代码生成中测试时强化学习的熵正则化秩掩码策略优化
summary_translated: 现有的测试时强化学习（TTRL）方法依赖于无标签测试任务上答案级别的自我投票来获取奖励，但这种方法在代码生成中失效，因为程序无法通过表面形式进行比较，因而不直接提供可用的训练信号。为使TTRL适用于代码生成，我们提出探针驱动的TTRL，从问题陈述构建无需输出的探针输入，执行候选程序在这些探针上的运行，并根据结果的行为一致性定义探针共识奖励（PCR）。PCR为开放词汇程序提供了行为训练信号，但并非完全可靠的验证器，仍易受虚假共识导致的奖励欺骗影响。因此，我们引入熵正则化秩掩码策略优化（ERPO），通过秩掩码将低PCR转化为保守的负更新，并通过熵上限控制策略漂移。在编码基准测试中，ERPO显著提升了域内适应和零样本迁移下的pass@1和pass@k性能。

summary: Execution feedback can guide coding agents toward correct repository repairs, but only when the tests capture the behavior requested by the issue. Agent-generated tests can encode incomplete or incorrect behavioral targets; when the same trajectory writes both the patch and the test, their errors can agree and create false confidence. We introduce ExecCritic, combining a test--verify--revise scaffold with a role-specific reinforcement learning recipe for training agents within it. The scaffold separates test construction from source-code repair: a Test agent independently generates repository-native tests, a fail-closed harness qualifies and freezes them, and a Repair agent revises source code from their execution feedback without changing the tests. Both roles use Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B as the backbone and are trained separately. In Learn to Test, the Test agent learns to produce behaviorally valid tests that distinguish correct from incorrect patches. In Test to Improve, the Repair agent learns both direct task resolution and feedback-guided revision. On SWE-bench Verified, test quality determines whether feedback helps: holding the base Repair agent fixed, tests from the base Test agent reduce resolved rate from a no-test baseline of 61.2% to 57.3%, whereas tests from GPT-5.6-sol raise it to 65.3%. Role-specific post-training raises the Qwen Test agent's Base-to-Gold success from 22.2% to 62.2%; composing the two post-trained Qwen agents reaches 72.6%, an 11.4-point gain over the original no-test baseline without stronger-model or Oracle feedback at evaluation time. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/execcritic.
title: ExecCritic: Learn to Test, Test to Improve for Coding Agents
comment: 35 pages
title_translated: ExecCritic：学会测试，通过测试改进编码智能体
summary_translated: 执行反馈可以引导编码智能体完成正确的仓库修复，但前提是测试能准确捕捉问题所请求的行为。智能体生成的测试可能编码不完整或错误的行为目标；当同一轨迹同时编写补丁和测试时，它们的错误可能一致，从而产生虚假信心。我们引入ExecCritic，结合测试-验证-修订框架与角色专用强化学习训练方案，用于在其中训练智能体。该框架将测试构建与源代码修复分离：测试智能体独立生成原生仓库测试，一个闭合失败的封装器对测试进行资格审查并冻结，修复智能体则根据测试执行反馈修改源代码而不改变测试。两个角色均使用Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B作为骨干，并分别训练。在‘学会测试’阶段，测试智能体学习生成行为有效的测试，以区分正确与错误的补丁；在‘通过测试改进’阶段，修复智能体学习直接解决任务和反馈引导的修订。在SWE-bench Verified上，测试质量决定了反馈是否有效：固定基础修复智能体，基础测试智能体的测试使解决率从无测试基线的61.2%降至57.3%，而GPT-5.6-sol的测试将其提升至65.3%。角色专用微调后，Qwen测试智能体的基线到黄金成功率从22.2%提升至62.2%；组合两个微调后的Qwen智能体达到72.6%，比原始无测试基线高出11.4个百分点，且无需更强模型或Oracle反馈即可在评估时实现。代码已公开于https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/execcritic。

summary: While research on recursive self-improvement (RSI) has predominantly automated model training pipelines, reliable autonomous development demands a missing pillar: post-hoc monitoring and auditing to understand what models learn and ensure safe alignment. Mechanistic interpretability tools are essential to bridge this gap, among which Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) serve as a cornerstone by isolating interpretable features for model inspection and steering. In this paper, we introduce SAEScientist-Bench to evaluate whether AI agents can act as scientists utilizing SAE tools for autonomous mechanistic discovery. Given a target concept, an agent designs contrastive probes and navigates a Gemma Scope dictionary of 131K+ features in Gemma-2-9B-IT to discover the optimal feature, evaluated against curated expert reference features anchored on Neuronpedia across activation rank, concept selectivity on contrastive texts, and causal steering. Across 10 agent configurations and 20 tasks, frontier agents demonstrate genuine discovery capabilities and lead different evaluation dimensions, but remain well behind the expert baseline, approaching expert levels on separating target concepts from contrastive controls while lagging substantially in causal generation steering. Further analysis reveals that although agents can design contrasts to rule out spurious candidates, they frequently misinterpret experimental measurements. These results establish experimental model understanding as a measurable capability for closed-loop autonomous AI R&D. Our code is available at https://github.com/Trae1ounG/SAEScientist.
title: SAEScientist-Bench: Can AI Agents Conduct Autonomous SAE Interpretability Research?
comment: Preprint. Work in Progress
title_translated: SAEScientist-Bench：AI智能体能否自主开展SAE可解释性研究？
summary_translated: 尽管关于递归自我改进（RSI）的研究主要自动化了模型训练流程，但可靠自主开发仍缺少关键支柱：事后监控与审计，以理解模型学到了什么并确保安全对齐。机制可解释性工具对于弥合这一差距至关重要，其中稀疏自动编码器（SAEs）作为基石，通过隔离可解释特征供模型检查与引导。本文介绍SAEScientist-Bench，用于评估AI智能体是否能够作为科学家，利用SAE工具实现自主机制发现。给定一个目标概念，智能体设计对比探针，并在Gemma-2-9B-IT的Gemmascope字典（超过13.1万个特征）中导航，以发现最优特征，依据专家参考特征进行评估，这些特征锚定在Neuronpedia上，涵盖激活等级、对比文本上的概念选择性以及因果引导能力。在10种智能体配置和20项任务中，前沿智能体展现出真实的发现能力，并在不同评估维度上领先，但仍远落后于专家基线，在分离目标概念与对比控制方面接近专家水平，但在因果生成引导方面明显滞后。进一步分析表明，虽然智能体能设计对比实验排除虚假候选，但常误读实验测量结果。这些结果确立了实验型模型理解为闭环自主AI研发中可衡量的能力。代码可在https://github.com/Trae1ounG/SAEScientist获取。

summary: Chain-of-thought reasoning provides a structured computation between a model's input and final answer. Yet it is often evaluated through endpoint accuracy, which ignores the path taken to reach that answer. An emerging line of work addresses this limitation using entropy profiles, which track how uncertainty evolves over the reasoning process but do not reveal which competing hypotheses account for that uncertainty. We introduce answer-distribution trajectories, a stochastic-dynamics-inspired representation that tracks the model's full predictive distribution over answers as reasoning unfolds. As a strictly finer representation than endpoint and entropy summaries, answer-distribution trajectories enable us to characterize a trace through a dynamical reasoning profile spanning exploration, revision, motion, and commitment, and to distinguish different dynamical mechanisms of reasoning success and failure. Across sixteen open-weight language models and four reasoning benchmarks, we show that traces with the same endpoint and similar entropy profiles can exhibit substantially different reasoning dynamics. We further find substantial variation in these dynamics both within and across models and tasks, with different objectives favoring different dynamical profiles. Additionally, we show that training and inference choices systematically reshape these profiles. Our results suggest that answer-distribution trajectories provide a rich framework for analysing and evaluating the dynamics of LLM reasoning.
title: Answer-Distribution Trajectories: A Stochastic-Dynamics View of LLM Reasoning

title_translated: 答案分布轨迹：大语言模型推理的随机动力学视角
summary_translated: 思维链推理为模型输入与最终答案之间提供了结构化计算过程。然而，通常仅通过终点准确率进行评估，忽略了达到该答案所经历的路径。现有研究通过熵谱来追踪推理过程中不确定性的演变，但无法揭示导致不确定性的竞争性假设。我们提出答案分布轨迹，一种受随机动力学启发的表示方法，能够跟踪推理展开过程中模型对答案的完整预测分布。相较于终点和熵谱总结，这是一种更精细的表示，使我们能够刻画从探索、修正、运动到承诺的动态推理轨迹，并区分推理成功与失败的不同动态机制。在十六个开源语言模型和四个推理基准上，我们发现具有相同终点和相似熵谱的轨迹可能表现出显著不同的推理动态。此外，我们还发现这些动态在模型内部及跨模型、跨任务间存在显著差异，不同目标偏好不同的动态特征。同时，训练和推理选择会系统性地重塑这些动态特征。结果表明，答案分布轨迹为分析和评估大语言模型推理动态提供了一个丰富框架。

summary: Language-model checkpoints are commonly selected by pretraining loss or benchmark scores, assuming that the highest-scoring checkpoint will remain the best starting point for subsequent training. We show that this assumption can fail in a full 30B mixture-of-experts training pipeline. The checkpoints that perform better after the full downstream training stack also have higher solution density, i.e., retain downstream performance under local weight perturbations.
title: Good Pretraining, Bad SFT: Checkpoint Quality Across the Training Stack
title_translated: 良好的预训练，糟糕的SFT：训练栈中检查点质量的分析
summary_translated: 语言模型检查点通常根据预训练损失或基准得分进行选择，假设得分最高的检查点将始终是后续训练的最佳起点。我们展示了这一假设在完整的30B专家混合训练管道中可能失效。经过完整下游训练栈后表现更好的检查点也具有更高的解密度，即在局部权重扰动下仍能保持下游性能。

summary: Ensuring the safety of autonomous driving is a critical challenge. Scenario-based testing is a systematic process used to validate Autonomous Driving Systems (ADSs), but it remains a fragmented modular pipeline in which scenario generation, retrieval, modification, ADS execution, and results analysis are performed by separate tools with little interaction. Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise across ADS sub-systems such as perception, planning, and control. However, no prior work covers the whole scenario-based testing pipeline for ADSs with a unified LLM-agent framework. We present PlannerForge, an LLM-agent framework that extends all scenario-based testing stages (from Scenario Generation to ADS Assessment) and adds two further LLM-enhanced stages: ADS Enhancement and ADS Benchmarking. We evaluate PlannerForge with 10 off-the-shelf LLMs across all tasks (Generation, Selection, Modification, Module Routing, Planner Testing, and Enhancement) under 5 prompt conditions. Best-per-task scores range from 0.88 to 1.00, and open-source 20-35B backends match commercial APIs on most tasks. Open-source models such as Qwen3.6:35B match commercial APIs on three of the five tasks. Chaining the modules end-to-end retains 83% / 78% of seed queries (commercial / open). It outperforms Scenario Factory 2.0 (Finkeldei et al., 2025) on natural-language generation (193 vs. 144 executable of 200) and realises 92-96% of requested city, road and vehicle attributes. It outperforms BM25 (Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009) at rank 1 selection (92.0% vs. 67.5%) and From-Words-to-Collisions (Gao et al., 2025) on physically valid edits (>=94% vs. 31%). At N=400, cost-tuning lifts planner success from 50.4% to 70.2% and cuts collisions from 19.0% to 8.4%, without domain-specific fine-tuning.
title: PlannerForge: LLM Agents for Scenario-Based Testing of Motion Planners in Autonomous Driving

title_translated: PlannerForge：用于自动驾驶运动规划器场景测试的LLM智能体
summary_translated: 确保自动驾驶的安全性是一个关键挑战。基于场景的测试是一种系统化流程，用于验证自动驾驶系统（ADS），但目前仍是一个碎片化的模块化流程，其中场景生成、检索、修改、ADS执行和结果分析由不同工具完成，交互极少。大型语言模型（LLM）智能体已在感知、规划和控制等ADS子系统中展现出潜力。然而，此前尚无工作以统一的LLM智能体框架覆盖ADS的整个基于场景的测试流程。我们提出PlannerForge，一个扩展了所有基于场景测试阶段（从场景生成到ADS评估）的LLM智能体框架，并新增两个LLM增强阶段：ADS增强和ADS基准测试。我们在5种提示条件下，使用10个现成的LLM对所有任务（生成、选择、修改、模块路由、规划器测试和增强）进行了评估。各任务最佳得分范围为0.88至1.00，开源20-35B后端在大多数任务上可媲美商业API。例如，Qwen3.6:35B在三个任务上达到与商业API相当的水平。端到端串联模块保留了83% / 78%的种子查询（商业/开源）。其在自然语言生成方面优于Scenario Factory 2.0（Finkeldei等，2025）（200条中有193条可执行 vs. 144条），并实现了请求的城市、道路和车辆属性的92%-96%覆盖率。在排名1的选择上优于BM25（Robertson和Zaragoza，2009）（92.0% vs. 67.5%），在物理有效编辑方面优于From-Words-to-Collisions（Gao等，2025）（≥94% vs. 31%）。在N=400时，成本调优将规划器成功率从50.4%提升至70.2%，碰撞率从19.0%降至8.4%，且无需领域特定微调。

summary: We introduce AuK, an open-source foundational model that unifies speech generation and editing through a common interface of natural-language instructions and audio context. To support this broad capability set, we construct approximately 3.03 billion instruction--audio instances and 1.95 million hours of effective supervision across five task families: speech generation, content editing, enhancement and separation, paralinguistic editing, and acoustic editing. AuK combines a multimodal large language model for semantic conditioning, an VAE jointly trained on speech, general audio, and music for acoustic conditioning, and a hybrid rectified-flow Transformer that performs dual-stream MMDiT blocks followed by unified single-stream DiT blocks for generation. Training begins with generation-only warm-up and proceeds to joint generation--editing pre-training. We then apply complementary post-training strategies: human-feedback preference optimization for open-ended editing and reward-based reinforcement learning for speech generation. To reduce inference cost, we further distill the model with consistency initialization and task-routed Decoupled DMD. The resulting AuK-Flash performs 4-step inference without classifier-free guidance and achieves a 4.5 wall-clock speedup over the full model under matched conditions. Experiments demonstrate leading performance on zero-shot and instruction-controlled speech generation and general instruction-guided editing, while remaining competitive on signal-level restoration tasks. We release both the source code and model weights to support reproducibility and further research.
title: AuK Technical Report: An Open-Source Foundational Model for Speech Generation and Editing
comment: Open-source at this https URL
title_translated: AuK技术报告：面向语音生成与编辑的开源基础模型
summary_translated: 我们介绍AuK，一个开源的基础模型，通过自然语言指令和音频上下文的统一接口实现语音生成与编辑的融合。为支持这一广泛能力，我们构建了约30.3亿个指令-音频实例和195万小时的有效监督数据，涵盖五大任务类别：语音生成、内容编辑、增强与分离、副语言编辑以及声学编辑。AuK结合了多模态大语言模型用于语义条件控制，一个在语音、通用音频和音乐上联合训练的VAE用于声学条件控制，以及一个混合的修正流Transformer，采用双流MMDiT块后接统一单流DiT块进行生成。训练从仅生成的预热开始，进入生成-编辑联合预训练阶段。随后应用互补的后训练策略：人类反馈偏好优化用于开放式编辑，基于奖励的强化学习用于语音生成。为降低推理成本，我们进一步通过一致性初始化和任务路由解耦DMD进行模型压缩。最终的AuK-Flash在无分类器自由引导的情况下实现4步推理，在相同条件下比全模型快4.5倍。实验表明，AuK在零样本和指令控制语音生成以及通用指令引导编辑方面表现领先，同时在信号级恢复任务中仍具竞争力。我们发布源代码和模型权重，以支持可复现性和进一步研究。

summary: Speech deepfakes can mimic a speaker's voice convincingly enough to deceive listeners and automated systems. This has driven strong progress in speech deepfake detection, but most detectors still end with one score per utterance. That score is useful for ranking systems, yet it says little about why a borderline item should be trusted, deferred, or reviewed. Two utterances can fall in the same score band for different reasons, for example because passive and retrieval evidence disagree or because the keyed probe is unavailable. We ask whether the final decision can remain scalar without discarding that provenance. We answer this question with an auditable decision record that carries four aligned cues into a late calibration step: a passive detector score, a conditional keyed-probe score on a marked derivative, retrieval support, and a speaker-profile margin, together with explicit disagreement coordinates. On the 4,080-example ASVspoof 5 Track 1 matched subset, the fixed retrieval-augmented rule improves on retrieval-only evidence, from 15.84 percent to 11.91 percent EER, and late calibration over the full record reaches 8.43 percent EER. At a 33.75 percent review budget, the exposed cue union covers 82.85 percent of the calibrated model's errors. The best passive WavLM run still reaches 6.71 percent EER, so we do not present the decision record as a stronger standalone detector. Its contribution is to preserve the evidence behind each surfaced utterance while still producing one operating score for thresholding and review.
title: From Scores to Evidence: Auditable Decisions Can Improve Speech Deepfake Detection
title_translated: 从分数到证据：可审计决策可提升语音深度伪造检测
summary_translated: 语音深度伪造可以逼真地模仿说话人声音，足以欺骗听者和自动系统。这推动了语音深度伪造检测的快速发展，但大多数检测器仍仅输出每个语音片段的一个分数。该分数适用于系统排序，却难以解释为何某个边界项应被信任、延迟或审查。两个语音片段可能处于同一分数区间，但原因不同，例如被动检测与检索证据不一致，或关键探测器不可用。我们探讨是否可以在不丢弃来源信息的前提下，让最终决策保持标量形式。我们通过可审计决策记录回答此问题，该记录在后期校准步骤中携带四个对齐线索：被动检测器分数、标记衍生品上的条件性关键探测分数、检索支持以及说话人档案边际值，并附带明确的分歧坐标。在包含4,080个样本的ASVspoof 5 Track 1匹配子集上，固定检索增强规则将检索仅证据的错误等价率（EER）从15.84%降至11.91%，而对完整记录进行后期校准可达到8.43% EER。在33.75%的审查预算下，暴露的线索联合覆盖了校准模型错误的82.85%。最佳被动WavLM运行仍达到6.71% EER，因此我们不将决策记录视为更强的独立检测器。其贡献在于保留每个被揭示语音片段背后的证据，同时仍生成一个可用于阈值设定和审查的操作分数。

summary: Evaluating first-stage retrievers in large-scale production RAG requires a benchmark that pairs a large-scale corpus with a large set of agent-reformulated search queries based on real user queries and their conversation threads, and that labels many relevant documents per query. No existing public benchmark evaluates this setting: large-scale collections typically provide only a small number of evaluation queries, whereas benchmarks with many queries generally contain only millions of documents. Moreover, most benchmarks assess human-written queries, while the first-stage retrievers in agentic RAG pipelines serve machine-written reformulations whose distribution differs from human search behavior. To overcome these evaluation gaps, we introduce Q2D-Web (Query2Doc-Web), a large-scale agentic retrieval benchmark consisting of a 190M-document web corpus and 70k agentic search queries in ten languages, reformulated from real-world user queries in production systems. Q2D-Web provides three sets of fixed relevance judgments: agent citations, production rankings, and a combined set that unions both signals and adds LLM-based judgments of unlabeled pooled documents to reduce false negatives. We benchmark 13 retrievers including lexical, dense, and late-interaction models and find that their relative ordering is largely insensitive to the choice of judgment set, while diverging substantially across topical domains, query languages, and query types. To enable fast evaluation, we also study subcorpus sampling as an approximation to full-corpus evaluations. Retaining a third of the corpus, selected by reciprocal rank fusion over pooled retriever runs, preserves the full-corpus model ranking under the combined judgments while raising absolute Recall@1000 only by 3 to 7 points. The public leaderboard is accessible under: https://huggingface.co/spaces/perplexity-ai/q2d-web-leaderboard
title: Q2D-Web: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Retrieval in Agentic RAG Systems
title_translated: Q2D-Web：面向智能体RAG系统的检索大规模基准测试
summary_translated: 在大规模生产级RAG系统中评估第一阶段检索器，需要一个将大规模语料库与基于真实用户查询及其对话线程重构的智能体搜索查询配对，并为每个查询标注大量相关文档的基准。现有公开基准无法满足这一需求：大规模语料库通常仅提供少量评估查询，而拥有大量查询的基准则一般仅包含数百万文档。此外，大多数基准评估的是人工编写的查询，而智能体RAG流水线中的第一阶段检索器处理的是机器生成的重写查询，其分布与人类搜索行为不同。为弥补这些评估空白，我们提出了Q2D-Web（Query2Doc-Web），一个大规模智能体检索基准，包含1.9亿文档的网络语料库和来自生产系统中真实用户查询的7万个跨十种语言的智能体搜索查询。Q2D-Web提供了三组固定的相关性判断：智能体引用、生产排序结果，以及结合两者并加入LLM对未标注文档的判断以减少假阴性。我们对13种检索器（包括词法、密集型和后期交互模型）进行了基准测试，发现其相对排序在不同判断集之间基本不变，但在主题领域、查询语言和查询类型上存在显著差异。为实现快速评估，我们还研究了子语料采样作为全语料评估的近似方法。保留三分之一的语料库（通过合并检索器运行结果的倒数排名融合选择），在联合判断下可保持全语料库的模型排序，同时仅使Recall@1000绝对值下降3至7个百分点。公开排行榜可通过以下链接访问：https://huggingface.co/spaces/perplexity-ai/q2d-web-leaderboard

summary: When an external reference set (an anchor) is used to decompose an LLM-judge panel's error into a quality signal and a shared common-mode error, standard practice assumes the anchor is uncontaminated: its error uncorrelated with the judges' shared error. We study when that assumption can be dropped and replaced by an estimate. Under a single-common-factor model, >=2 judges and >=2 anchors point-identify the quality variance, the common-mode variance, and each anchor's contamination correlation rho_k in closed form, with an exact per-anchor-pair failure boundary; a designated clean-anchor estimator, by contrast, reports a contaminated companion anchor as fully clean once its trusted anchor is itself contaminated. Because the single-common-factor assumption is itself untestable, the estimator ships gated behind a calibrated diagnostic battery (judge-covariance dispersion; over-identification; a family-block test from judge metadata, with a family-blocked estimator that removes family-level shared-residual bias exactly), bootstrap confidence intervals with measured coverage, and a weak-identification screen. A proposition maps which violations bias rho_k, in which direction, and which evade detection. For ordinal scores we show an identification hierarchy: with all variables ordinal, rho_k is not identified at any number of anchors; with ordinal judges and >=3 continuous anchors it is, and we give an estimator for that case. On real data the validation is asymmetric, and we say so plainly: the diagnostics are validated in the rejecting direction (both real panels we test are correctly rejected by the model-adequacy pre-test), while the estimator is validated in simulation and stress-tested semi-synthetically under oracle calibration; no real panel has yet passed the pre-test, and the pre-test exists precisely to say so. All results replay offline from shipped, checksummed artifacts.
title: A Closed-Form Estimator and Diagnostic Battery for Anchor-Judge Error Correlation, Under a Single-Common-Factor Model

title_translated: 锚点-评判者误差相关性的闭式估计器与诊断套件：基于单一共同因子模型
summary_translated: 当使用外部参考集（锚点）将LLM评判小组的误差分解为质量信号和共享的共同模式误差时，标准做法假设锚点是纯净的：其误差与评判者的共享误差无关。我们研究了该假设可被替代为估计值的情形。在单一共同因子模型下，至少两名评判者和至少两个锚点可闭式识别质量方差、共同模式方差以及每个锚点的污染相关性rho_k，具有精确的每对锚点失败边界；相比之下，指定的清洁锚点估计器在可信锚点被污染后，会错误地将污染锚点报告为完全清洁。由于单一共同因子假设本身不可检验，该估计器配备了经过校准的诊断套件（评判者协方差离散度；过度识别检验；基于评判者元数据的家庭块检验，以及去除家庭层级共享残差偏倚的块化估计器）、带测量覆盖率的自助法置信区间，以及弱识别筛查机制。一个命题明确了哪些违反条件会以何种方向偏差rho_k，以及哪些能逃避检测。对于序数评分，我们展示了识别层次结构：当所有变量均为序数时，rho_k在任何锚点数量下均无法识别；当评判者为序数且至少有三个连续锚点时，可识别，并给出了该情况下的估计器。在真实数据上，验证呈非对称性，我们明确指出：诊断套件在拒绝方向上得到验证（我们测试的所有真实评判组均被模型适配性预检正确拒绝），而估计器在模拟中验证并在Oracle校准下半合成压力测试中验证；目前尚无真实评判组通过预检，而预检的存在正是为了表明这一点。所有结果均可从已发布的、带校验和的成果中离线重现。

summary: Weak-to-strong generalization asks whether stronger models can learn from weaker supervisors and surpass them. This question is particularly important for successive model generations and multi-domain consolidation, where repeating frontier-scale post-training from scratch can be prohibitively expensive. Yet conventional distillation treats the weak teacher as an optimization target, potentially imposing its capacity ceiling on the student. We introduce On-Policy Reverse Distillation (OPRD), which evaluates the teacher's policy shift relative to its reference policy on student rollouts and amplifies the component of the student's verifier-driven policy gradient along that direction. By rescaling only verifier-supported updates, OPRD preserves the stationary points of policy optimization while accelerating learning beyond the teacher. In both successive model transfer and multi-teacher distillation, OPRD achieves higher performance with fewer student updates than existing RL and distillation approaches. Response-style analysis shows that OPRD students remain closer to models trained with verifier-based RL alone than to their weak teachers, suggesting that teacher guidance accelerates rather than redirects the student's own optimization. Results in conventional strong-to-weak distillation further demonstrate that OPRD effectively combines verifier-driven policy optimization with teacher guidance regardless of capacity ordering.
title: Eliciting Weak-to-Strong Generalization with On-Policy Reverse Distillation

title_translated: 通过策略内逆向蒸馏实现弱到强泛化能力的激发
summary_translated: 弱到强泛化问题探讨更强模型能否从较弱的监督者中学习并超越其表现。这一问题在连续模型迭代和多领域整合中尤为重要，因为重复进行前沿规模的从头后训练可能代价高昂。然而，传统蒸馏将弱教师视为优化目标，可能将其容量上限施加于学生模型。我们提出策略内逆向蒸馏（OPRD），通过评估教师策略相对于其参考策略在学生轨迹上的变化，并放大学生验证器驱动策略梯度中沿该方向的成分来实现。OPRD仅重新缩放验证器支持的更新，从而在不破坏策略优化驻点的同时，加速学习超越教师的表现。在连续模型迁移和多教师蒸馏场景中，OPRD在更少的学生更新次数下实现了比现有强化学习和蒸馏方法更高的性能。响应风格分析显示，OPRD学生模型更接近仅使用验证器驱动强化学习训练的模型，而非其弱教师，表明教师指导加速而非引导了学生自身的优化过程。在常规的强到弱蒸馏实验中，进一步证明OPRD能有效结合验证器驱动的策略优化与教师指导，无论容量顺序如何。

summary: The Ising model is extended to the Potts model for multinomial data. We introduce a Rater Ising-Potts model that uses agreement indicators between pairs of raters and category labels, with weights derived from LLM embeddings. The model does not presuppose ordered category thresholds or equidistant scoring; instead, it focuses directly on pairwise agreement among raters and assigns category-specific positive weights, making it particularly suited for multi-category scoring reliability when raters evaluate responses using a scoring guide. We demonstrate the model's effectiveness on diverse constructed-response tasks, including balanced short-answer items and more challenging, imbalanced essay prompts from the AERA dataset. Across these settings, the model achieves strong agreement with human scores, with the vast majority of misclassifications occurring between adjacent score levels, confirming its ability to preserve the ordinal structure of scoring rubrics without imposing rigid assumptions. A practical similarity normalization and optional power transformation is introduced as a tunable preprocessing step that sharpens semantic distinctions and can be adapted to different datasets. These findings suggest that LLM-derived semantic similarities, combined with this parsimonious Potts-type formulation and flexible similarity scaling, offer a robust and interpretable framework for reliability auditing in educational assessment contexts. Extensions to multiple raters and hierarchical rating processes are discussed.
title: The Rater Ising-Potts Model with LLM-Derived Weights: An Application to Multi-Category Scoring Reliability
title_translated: 基于LLM衍生权重的评判者Ising-Potts模型：多类别评分可靠性应用
summary_translated: Ising模型扩展为适用于多项式数据的Potts模型。我们引入了评判者Ising-Potts模型，利用成对评判者之间的同意指标和类别标签，权重由LLM嵌入生成。该模型不预设有序类别阈值或等距评分；相反，它直接关注评判者间的成对一致性，并为各类别分配特定正权重，特别适用于评判者使用评分指南评估回答时的多类别评分可靠性。我们在多种构造式回答任务中展示了该模型的有效性，包括平衡的简答题目和来自AERA数据集更具挑战性的不平衡作文题。在这些场景中，模型与人工评分高度一致，绝大多数误分类发生在相邻评分等级之间，证实了其在不施加严格假设的前提下保留评分量表序数结构的能力。我们引入了一种实用的相似性归一化及可选的幂变换作为可调预处理步骤，可增强语义区分度，并适应不同数据集。这些发现表明，结合LLM衍生的语义相似性、简洁的Potts型公式和灵活的相似性缩放，为教育评估中的可靠性审计提供了一个稳健且可解释的框架。还讨论了多评判者和分层评分流程的扩展。

summary: Large language model (LLM) benchmarks are often treated as fixed datasets with stable scores, yet their outcomes depend on configurable evaluation pipelines. We audit eight cybersecurity benchmarks across 10 proprietary, open-weight, and cybersecurity-specialized LLMs. By modeling benchmarks as measurement pipelines, we identify 15 systematic failure modes and show that a single pipeline choice can change a model's score by more than 80 percentage points and substantially alter model rankings. At the cross-benchmark level, two semantically similar task pairs rank the same models differently because of incompatible evaluation conventions. Under an evaluation harness that standardizes pipeline choices while preserving task semantics, nine of 10 models shift by at least three ranks on at least one benchmark. These results show that cybersecurity LLM benchmark scores are pipeline-dependent and motivate pipeline-aware auditing as a core requirement for reliable model evaluation.
title: Benchmark Scores Are Pipeline-Dependent: A Reliability Audit of Cybersecurity LLM Benchmarks
title_translated: 基准分数依赖于流水线：对网络安全LLM基准的可靠性审计
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）基准常被视为固定数据集和稳定分数，但其结果实际上依赖于可配置的评估流水线。我们对八项网络安全基准在十种专有、开源权重和网络安全专用LLM上进行了审计。通过将基准建模为测量流水线，我们识别出15种系统性失效模式，并表明单一流水线选择可使模型得分变动超过80个百分点，显著改变模型排名。在跨基准层面，两个语义相似的任务对同一模型排名不同，原因在于评估惯例不兼容。在一种标准化流水线选择但保留任务语义的评估框架下，十种模型中有九种在至少一项基准上排名变动不少于三位。这些结果表明，网络安全LLM基准分数具有流水线依赖性，强调了在可靠模型评估中实施流水线感知审计的核心必要性。

summary: Text-to-speech systems often face a trade-off between natural prosody and efficient inference: higher perceptual quality typically comes at increased computational cost and latency. We present TontaubeV1, a model that preserves natural prosody while enabling streaming from a single consumer GPU. Speech is encoded by the hierarchical DualCodec representation at 12.5 Hz, which separates a semantic stream from successive acoustic refinements. Our design assumes that prosodic structure is largely established when the semantic stream is generated, and allocates capacity accordingly: a Qwen3-1.7B-derived transformer predicts that stream and thereby the utterance duration, while three progressively smaller Qwen3-0.6B-derived transformers each add one acoustic refinement. Text is tokenized per character rather than by subword. Paired text and audio markers at shared positions support long-form generation with bounded context, and overlapping DualCodec reconstructions are mapped into the VibeVoice acoustic latent space and decoded causally, enabling streaming despite DualCodec's noncausal decoder. The model accepts up to one minute of reference audio for voice conditioning and is designed primarily for English and German, with additional multilingual support. The four predictors total 2.9B parameters; on a single RTX 5090 the streaming path reaches approximately 200 ms to first audio. In separate non-streaming measurements, the end-to-end real-time factor (RTF) is 0.08 for one input and the aggregate RTF is 0.02 across eight concurrent inputs. On our LLM-as-a-judge audiobook-reading benchmark, TontaubeV1 matches ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 and outperforms Fish Audio S2 Pro, the April 2026 Gradium API, and Cartesia Sonic 3 on prosody. The model weights are released on Hugging Face under the Tontaube Community Model License 1.0.
title: TontaubeV1: Streaming Text-to-Speech with Hierarchical Codec Modeling and Bounded Context

title_translated: TontaubeV1：基于分层编码器建模与有限上下文的流式文本到语音合成
summary_translated: 文本到语音系统通常在自然语调与高效推理之间面临权衡：更高的感知质量往往伴随着更高的计算成本和延迟。我们提出TontaubeV1，一种在单个消费级GPU上实现流式输出的同时保持自然语调的模型。语音通过每秒12.5帧的分层DualCodec表示进行编码，将语义流与逐次声学优化分离。我们的设计假设当语义流生成时，语调结构已基本确立，并据此分配资源：一个基于Qwen3-1.7B的Transformer预测该语义流以确定话语时长，而三个逐渐缩小的基于Qwen3-0.6B的Transformer分别添加一次声学优化。文本按字符而非子词进行分词。共享位置的文本与音频标记支持长篇内容生成且上下文受限，重叠的DualCodec重建被映射到VibeVoice声学潜在空间并因果解码，从而在DualCodec非因果解码器的情况下仍实现流式输出。该模型可接受长达一分钟的参考音频用于语音条件控制，主要针对英语和德语设计，具备额外的多语言支持。四个预测器总计29亿参数；在单张RTX 5090上，流式路径的首音频延迟约为200毫秒。在独立的非流式测量中，端到端实时因子（RTF）为0.08（单输入），八并发输入下的总RTF为0.02。在LLM作为裁判的有声书朗读基准测试中，TontaubeV1的表现与ElevenLabs Flash v2.5相当，并优于Fish Audio S2 Pro、2026年4月Gradium API以及Cartesia Sonic 3的语调表现。模型权重已在Hugging Face上以Tontaube社区模型许可证1.0发布。

summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models expand model capacity without a proportional increase in training compute, but increasing sparsity makes reliable hyperparameter transfer challenging. In this work, we show that conventional hyperparameter scaling laws are insufficient for ultra-sparse MoEs: the optimal learning rate and batch size vary with activation ratio, and these shifts cannot be explained by either total or activated parameter count alone. To characterize this dependence, we conduct 1,800 pre-training runs spanning six activated-parameter scales and models with up to 6B total non-embedding parameters, processing approximately 20 trillion tokens at a cost of 200,000 equivalent H800 GPU-hours. Our results reconcile conflicting findings in prior work by revealing two scaling regimes. At fixed sparsity, the optimal batch size follows a power-law relationship with training tokens $D$, whereas the optimal learning rate scales with training compute $C$ and remains robust to the allocation between model size and data. Across sparsity levels, the activation ratio $A$ enters both relationships as an additional multiplicative power-law factor. These observations lead to unified hyperparameter scaling laws that transfer across MoE sparsity levels. Large-scale evaluation shows that the scaling form outperforms alternative functional forms. On a held-out ultra-sparse MoE with 12B total parameters and only 1/64 of its experts activated, the predicted hyperparameters remain close to the observed optima, supporting joint extrapolation across model scale and sparsity. Further experiments demonstrate transfer across expert granularities and isolate the effect of activation ratio from that of total expert count.
title: Hyperparameter Scaling Laws Across MoE Sparsity
title_translated: 跨MoE稀疏性的超参数缩放规律
summary_translated: 混合专家（MoE）模型能够在不按比例增加训练计算量的情况下扩展模型容量，但提高稀疏性会使可靠的超参数迁移变得困难。本文表明，传统的超参数缩放规律对超稀疏MoE模型不足：最优学习率和批量大小随激活比例变化，这些变化无法仅由总参数量或激活参数量解释。为刻画这一依赖关系，我们进行了1800次预训练实验，覆盖六种激活参数规模，模型总非嵌入参数高达60亿，处理约20万亿token，耗时约20万等效H800 GPU小时。研究结果通过揭示两种缩放模式，调和了先前研究中的矛盾发现。在固定稀疏度下，最优批量大小与训练样本数$D$呈幂律关系；而最优学习率则与训练算力$C$相关，并对模型规模与数据量之间的分配具有鲁棒性。在不同稀疏度水平下，激活比例$A$作为额外的乘法幂律因子同时影响两者。这些观察推导出统一的超参数缩放规律，可在不同MoE稀疏度间有效迁移。大规模评估显示，该缩放形式优于其他函数形式。在一个包含120亿总参数、仅激活1/64专家的保留超稀疏MoE上，预测的超参数仍接近实际最优值，支持模型规模与稀疏度的联合外推。进一步实验验证了在专家粒度间的迁移能力，并分离出激活比例的影响与总专家数量的影响。

summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has been central to the recent success of Large Reasoning Models. However, while RLVR significantly improves single-sample accuracy, it often fails to expand the model's intrinsic reasoning coverage (pass@k) due to limited exploration during training. To address this, we optimize the structural design of train-time rollouts to enhance pass@k. Our analysis identifies three key design principles: (1) difficulty-adaptive rollout can play an important role in expanding pass@k, beyond serving as an efficiency heuristic; (2) tree-based rollout outperforms parallel sampling in discovering correct answers; and (3) sentence-entropy-guided forking overcomes the localization phenomenon of token-level branching to maximize semantic diversity. Building on these insights, we propose DATPO (Difficulty-Adaptive Sentence-entropy-guided Tree-structured Policy Optimization). DATPO integrates difficulty-adaptive tree search with a sibling-diversity advantage term, explicitly promoting semantic diversity to expand reasoning coverage during training. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that DATPO outperforms baselines especially in pass@k, which directly translates to superior test-time scaling performance.
title: Difficulty-Adaptive Tree-Structured Policy Optimization for Expanding Reasoning Coverage in RLVR
title_translated: 面向强化学习可验证奖励中推理覆盖范围扩展的难度自适应树状策略优化
summary_translated: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是近期大型推理模型成功的关键。然而，尽管RLVR显著提升了单样本准确率，但在训练过程中由于探索有限，往往难以扩展模型内在的推理覆盖范围（pass@k）。为解决此问题，我们优化了训练阶段回溯轨迹的结构设计以增强pass@k。分析识别出三个关键设计原则：(1) 难度自适应回溯不仅可作为效率启发式，还能在扩展pass@k方面发挥重要作用；(2) 树状回溯优于并行采样，在发现正确答案方面表现更优；(3) 基于句子熵引导的分支可克服令牌级别分支的局部化现象，最大化语义多样性。基于这些洞见，我们提出DATPO（难度自适应句子熵引导的树状结构策略优化）。DATPO将难度自适应树搜索与兄弟节点多样性优势项结合，显式促进语义多样性，从而在训练期间扩展推理覆盖范围。在数学推理基准上的实验表明，DATPO在pass@k指标上显著优于基线方法，直接转化为更优的测试阶段可扩展性能。

summary: Evaluating tool-augmented LLM agents requires diverse, realistic user inputs yet most evaluation frameworks use flat role descriptions ("you are an angry customer") that produce near-identical conversations regardless of the underlying scenario. In this paper, we propose a three-tier persona vector with 23 operationalized dimensions: 6 categorical demographics (jurisdiction, age, channel, device, language proficiency, time availability), 12 continuous behavioral traits (patience, assertiveness, digital literacy, etc.) sampled with Gaussian noise around curated profile base vectors, and 5 continuous emotional states (frustration, anxiety, trust, confidence, stress) that shift in response to scenario context. Orthogonal to the persona, a 4-level query-complexity overlay controls utterance phrasing from direct to deliberately vague. We evaluate the persona model inside a synthetic data generation pipeline across 64,698 multi-turn conversations spanning 8 named profiles and 3 production corpora. Key findings: (i) a 15.8 percentage-point spread in agent goal-achievement across personas confirms trait vectors produce measurably different user behavior; (ii) the same persona behaves differently across scenarios due to scenario-reactive emotional state shifts, validating the scenario-reactive design; (iii) domain-specific projects show persona sensitivity on booking-flow compliance (~15-20 percentage points gap between tier-aware and pressure-test personas), demonstrating the model faithfully reproduces real-world difficulty distributions; (iv) seven rule-described trait correlations produce auditable co-occurrence patterns without requiring learned covariance matrices. The persona model is fully specified for reproduction.
title: A Three-Tier Persona Vector for Controllable User Simulation in Agentic Evaluation
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Extended treatment of the persona component of StateGen ( arXiv:2606.16307 )
title_translated: 用于代理评估中可控用户模拟的三层人格向量
summary_translated: 评估工具增强型大语言模型代理需要多样且真实的用户输入，但大多数评估框架使用扁平的角色描述（如“你是一个愤怒的客户”），导致无论底层场景如何，生成的对话几乎完全相同。本文提出一种包含23个可操作维度的三层人格向量：6个分类人口统计特征（管辖区域、年龄、沟通渠道、设备类型、语言熟练度、时间可用性）、12个连续行为特质（如耐心、强势程度、数字素养等），围绕精心设计的基准向量以高斯噪声采样，以及5个随场景上下文动态变化的连续情绪状态（挫败感、焦虑、信任、自信、压力）。人格向量与场景无关，另设一个四级查询复杂度叠加层，控制从直接到刻意模糊的表达方式。我们在合成数据生成管道中评估该人格模型，涵盖64,698轮多轮对话，涉及8个命名角色和3个生产语料库。关键发现包括：(i) 不同人格间代理目标达成率相差15.8个百分点，证实特质向量能产生可测量差异的用户行为；(ii) 同一人格在不同场景中表现不同，因情境响应的情绪状态变化，验证了情境响应设计的有效性；(iii) 在特定领域项目中，人格敏感性体现在预订流程合规性上（层级感知与压力测试人格间差距达15-20个百分点），表明模型能忠实再现真实世界难度分布；(iv) 七个规则定义的特质相关性产生可审计的共现模式，无需依赖学习的协方差矩阵。该人格模型完整指定，可完全复现。

summary: Recent large language models can emit task-progress signals that agent frameworks use to decide whether a task should continue or stop, yet whether a model can reliably report its task progress at every stage of a task, and where and how its reports fail, has not been studied systematically. We evaluate this ability on the public benchmark $τ^2$-bench and on StageIF, a controlled testbed in which reporting checkpoints are placed across the task's lifecycle. Both settings require reports at multiple task stages. We find that reporting reliability depends on the stage a task has reached, and that almost every deployed model we test is reliable at some stages and unreliable at others. Where reporting breaks down is not the same everywhere. Most deployed models lose accuracy once work is under way and recover once the task is done. The newest generation closes that mid-task drop and instead grows conservative at the finish line. Our study exposes a capability gap in task-progress reporting and provides an evaluation protocol that spans the whole course of task execution for this ability on which agent operation depends. The findings indicate that agent frameworks should not control task flow on the strength of the model's state reports alone.
title: The Unreliable Progress Bar: Can LLM Agents Reliably Report Task Progress Throughout Execution?

title_translated: 不可靠的进度条：大语言模型代理能否可靠地报告任务执行全过程的进展？
summary_translated: 近期的大语言模型能够发出任务进度信号，供代理框架判断任务是否应继续或终止，但模型是否能在任务每个阶段都可靠报告其进度，以及在何处、为何报告失败，尚未得到系统研究。我们在公开基准τ²-bench和StageIF（一个在任务生命周期中设置报告检查点的受控测试平台）上评估了这一能力。两个场景均要求在多个任务阶段进行报告。我们发现，报告可靠性取决于任务所处阶段，几乎所有测试的部署模型在某些阶段可靠而在其他阶段不可靠。报告失效的位置并非一致。大多数部署模型在工作开始后失去准确性，任务完成后恢复。最新一代模型则消除了任务中段的下降，反而在终点趋于保守。本研究揭示了任务进度报告中的能力缺口，并提供了一个贯穿任务执行全过程的评估协议，该能力对代理运行至关重要。研究结果表明，代理框架不应仅依赖模型的状态报告来控制任务流程。

summary: Large Language Models demonstrate remarkable proficiency in static reasoning, yet training them as autonomous agents through Reinforcement Learning (RL) for long-horizon tasks is often hindered by severe reward sparsity. While conventional \textit{agent-side warming} up via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can alleviate this, it is frequently limited by data scarcity and constrained exploration. To address this, we propose a paradigm shift to \textit{environment-side adaptation} by constructing \textbf{F}eedback-\textbf{E}nriched \textbf{E}nvironments (\textbf{FEEs}). Through a pilot study, we establish a feedback design strategy that reformulates environments by transitioning from action guidance to observation enrichment during the later stages of both intra-episode exploration and inter-episode evolution. Large-scale experiments on SciWorld and BFCL benchmarks using various Qwen3 model scales and RL algorithms such as GRPO, GSPO, and DAPO demonstrate that FEEs consistently yield performance improvements over standard settings. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that training with FEEs \textbf{(1)} stabilizes training dynamics by reducing entropy volatility, \textbf{(2)} facilitates proactive state-space exploration in difficult tasks, \textbf{(3) }ensures the internalization of environmental guidance into policy weights rather than acting as a mere inference-time prior, and \textbf{(4) }identifies intra-group feedback consistency as a critical boundary for stable optimization.
title: Environments as Scaffold: Enriching Feedback to Bootstrap Self-Evolving Agents in Long-Horizon Tasks

title_translated: 环境作为支架：通过增强反馈以启动长时程任务中的自演化智能体
summary_translated: 大型语言模型在静态推理方面表现出色，但通过强化学习（RL）训练它们作为自主智能体完成长时程任务时常受制于严重的奖励稀疏性。尽管传统的通过监督微调（SFT）进行的智能体侧预热可缓解此问题，但往往受限于数据稀缺性和探索能力不足。为此，我们提出一种范式转变，即采用环境侧适应，构建反馈增强型环境（FEEs）。通过初步研究，我们建立了一种反馈设计策略，该策略在单个episode内的探索阶段和episode间的演化阶段后期，将环境从动作指导转变为观察信息增强。在SciWorld和BFCL基准测试上，使用多种Qwen3模型规模及GRPO、GSPO和DAPO等RL算法进行的大规模实验表明，FEEs在性能上持续优于标准设置。此外，我们的分析揭示，使用FEEs训练具有以下优势：(1) 通过降低熵波动稳定训练动态；(2) 在困难任务中促进主动的状态空间探索；(3) 确保环境引导内化为策略权重，而非仅作为推理时的先验；(4) 识别组内反馈一致性是稳定优化的关键边界。

summary: Remote sensing multimodal large language models (RS-MLLMs) have advanced scene understanding and visual question answering over satellite imagery, yet localizing specific objects or changed regions remains challenging. Existing approaches rely on generating bounding box coordinates as token sequences, which is fragile for the small, densely packed objects common in remote sensing and increasingly error-prone when multiple targets must be localized simultaneously. In this work, we present an RS-specific formulation of the region selection paradigm, previously explored in natural-image MLLMs, and extend it to temporal change localization over multi-image sequences. Our framework employs a text-conditioned region proposal module, encodes each candidate as special tokens carrying per-frame visual features enriched with spatial and temporal cues, and lets the LLM localize targets by selecting region tokens in its response. We construct a multi-task training and evaluation suite spanning localization, referring expression, visual grounding, and understanding tasks across single-image and multi-temporal settings. Experiments show that our approach substantially outperforms coordinate-generation baselines on temporal change localization, while improving single-image visual grounding and maintaining competitive understanding performance. Oracle analysis decomposes the contributions of the region proposer and the LLM selector, providing diagnostic insight unique to this framework. Our code will be available at https://github.com/juwan-kr/RS-RegionSelect.
title: From Coordinates to Candidate Regions: Temporal Change Localization via Region Selection in Remote Sensing Multimodal LLMs

title_translated: 从坐标到候选区域：基于遥感多模态大模型的区域选择实现时间变化定位
summary_translated: 遥感多模态大语言模型（RS-MLLMs）已显著提升了卫星图像的场景理解与视觉问答能力，但定位特定对象或变化区域仍具挑战性。现有方法依赖生成边界框坐标作为标记序列，对遥感中常见的小而密集的对象脆弱，且在需同时定位多个目标时错误率逐渐升高。本文提出一种专为遥感设计的区域选择范式，此前已在自然图像多模态大模型中探索过，并将其扩展至多图像序列的时间变化定位。我们的框架采用文本条件化的区域提议模块，将每个候选区域编码为携带每帧视觉特征并融合空间与时间线索的特殊标记，让大模型通过在其响应中选择区域标记来定位目标。我们构建了一个涵盖单图与多时相设置下的定位、指代表达、视觉定位和理解任务的多任务训练与评估套件。实验表明，我们的方法在时间变化定位上显著优于坐标生成基线，同时提升单图视觉定位性能并保持竞争力的理解表现。Oracle分析分解了区域提议器与大模型选择器的贡献，提供了该框架独有的诊断洞察。代码将公开于 https://github.com/juwan-kr/RS-RegionSelect。

summary: We present Miles v0.1, a full-stack, production-ready system for frontier post-training. Building upon the clean design of slime, Miles designs each stage of the reinforcement-learning (RL) training loop around a single principle: components should be verified, clean, and customizable. With accuracy, efficiency, reliability, and scalability as first-class goals, Miles aims to make frontier-scale RL accessible to researchers and enterprises alike. This report walks through the system end to end: rollout engines built on SGLang, a trainer with a choice of two backends (NVIDIA Megatron-LM and PyTorch FSDP), and three weight-synchronization transports for different deployment topologies. Beyond full-parameter RL, Miles also supports LoRA RL, on-policy distillation, supervised fine-tuning, and true-on-policy rollout-training alignment, and extends the same architecture to diffusion models. We close with an end-to-end case study: fully asynchronous agentic RL on a GLM-5.2 744B-A40B model over terminal-use coding tasks, running on 64 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs with a median step time of 263 seconds over the first 30 measured steps. Miles is open-sourced at https://github.com/radixark/miles, with the project website at https://miles.radixark.com.
title: Miles v0.1: Production-Level Post-Training
comment: 34 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Technical report
title_translated: Miles v0.1：面向生产级别的后训练系统
summary_translated: 我们介绍Miles v0.1，一个全栈式、可投入生产的前沿后训练系统。基于slime的清晰设计，Miles围绕单一原则设计强化学习（RL）训练循环的每一阶段：组件应可验证、干净且可定制。以准确性、效率、可靠性和可扩展性为首要目标，Miles旨在使前沿规模的强化学习对研究人员和企业均触手可及。本报告全面介绍系统架构：基于SGLang构建的回放引擎，支持两种后端（NVIDIA Megatron-LM 和 PyTorch FSDP）的训练器，以及适用于不同部署拓扑的三种权重同步传输方式。除了全参数RL外，Miles还支持LoRA RL、在线策略蒸馏、监督微调以及真正的在线策略回放-训练对齐，并将相同架构扩展至扩散模型。最后，我们展示一个端到端案例研究：在终端使用编码任务上，基于GLM-5.2 744B-A40B模型，使用64块NVIDIA GB300 GPU实现完全异步的代理强化学习，前30个测量步骤的平均步耗时为263秒。Miles已在 https://github.com/radixark/miles 开源，项目官网为 https://miles.radixark.com。

summary: Solving repository-level code tasks requires LLM-based agents to use code search tools to navigate large codebases and identify a small set of relevant files and functions. However, current retrieval tools typically return flat lists of isolated code snippets: such lists can surface relevant files, but provide insufficient structure for agents to distinguish the target function from semantically similar alternatives in the same file. We introduce RepoNav, a lightweight post-retrieval interface that reorganizes retrieved snippets into a file-centered navigation scaffold. By presenting compact structural cues and candidate targets, this scaffold guides on-demand file-structure browsing, helping agents compare sibling symbols before selecting a target function. Across diverse models on LocBench, RepoNav improves function-level localization and narrows the file-to-function gap. Controlled ablations demonstrate that these gains come from structured evidence organization rather than simply exposing additional file structure, and the approach also improves performance on a repository-level question-answering benchmark.
title: RepoNav: From Snippet Retrieval to File-Centered Repository Navigation for Code Agents
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026
title_translated: RepoNav：从片段检索到面向文件的代码仓库导航用于代码智能体
summary_translated: 解决仓库级代码任务需要基于大语言模型的智能体使用代码搜索工具导航大型代码库，并识别出少量相关文件和函数。然而，当前的检索工具通常返回扁平的孤立代码片段列表：这类列表虽能暴露相关文件，但缺乏足够结构，使智能体难以区分同一文件中语义相似的替代函数。我们提出RepoNav，一种轻量级的后检索接口，将检索到的片段重新组织为以文件为中心的导航框架。通过呈现紧凑的结构线索和候选目标，该框架引导按需浏览文件结构，帮助智能体在选择目标函数前比较同级符号。在LocBench上的多种模型测试中，RepoNav提升了函数级定位能力，并缩小了文件到函数之间的差距。受控消融实验表明，这些提升源于结构化证据组织，而非简单暴露更多文件结构；该方法还在仓库级问答基准上提升了性能。

summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher knowledge on student-generated trajectories, but efficient sampled objectives reduce the teacher distribution to scalar credit on individual tokens. Such credit indicates whether a token should gain or lose probability, yet leaves the corresponding redistribution unspecified. We recast OPD as teacher-guided probability transport and propose RouteOPD (Routed On-Policy Distillation), which decomposes local teacher--student disagreement into student-excess sources and teacher-deficit destinations and couples them into explicit transport pairs. RouteOPD optimizes pairwise log-odds toward jointly realizable targets obtained from a bounded teacher potential, while adapting the transport budget to the concentration of teacher demand. This formulation directs updates toward teacher-preferred destinations and controls their magnitude within a single transport operator. Experiments across four teacher--student settings and four mathematical-reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that RouteOPD consistently outperforms sampled reverse-KL OPD, with improvements accompanied by higher routing fidelity and lower background leakage. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of explicitly modeling probability transport in on-policy distillation.
title: Distillation as Probability Transport: Routed On-Policy Distillation
title_translated: 蒸馏即概率传输：路由在线策略蒸馏
summary_translated: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）将教师模型的知识从学生生成的轨迹中迁移，但高效的采样目标会将教师分布简化为单个标记的标量信用。这种信用仅指示某标记应增加或减少概率，却未明确相应的概率重分配方式。我们将OPD重新建模为教师引导的概率传输，并提出RouteOPD（路由在线策略蒸馏），其将局部教师-学生分歧分解为学生过剩源与教师短缺目的地，并将其配对为显式的传输单元。RouteOPD通过优化成对对数几率，向由有界教师势能获得的联合可实现目标靠拢，同时根据教师需求集中度自适应调整传输预算。该公式引导更新朝向教师偏好的目标方向，并在单一传输算子内控制其幅度。在四个教师-学生配置和四个数学推理基准上的实验表明，RouteOPD始终优于采样反KL OPD，且伴随更高的路由保真度和更低的背景泄漏。结果证明在在线策略蒸馏中显式建模概率传输的有效性。

summary: We introduce HoneyRoute, an inference-serving layer that detects whether an incoming request is malicious and, if so, routes it to a dedicated honeypot model, shielding production while the adversary's interaction is continuously harvested for intelligence. Existing defenses embed traps inside model memory or rebuild deception at the protocol layer, leaving the serving tier unprotected and feeding nothing back into detection. HoneyRoute couples (i) a streaming router (a frozen 0.8B-embedding backbone with per-domain MLP heads), (ii) a dual-implementation honeypot (a rule/prompt-engineered code honeypot or a dedicated same-family replica), and (iii) an analysis loop that converts trapped interactions into attacker fingerprints for router retraining. On a production trace plus a seven-domain attack corpus, the router reaches F1=.911 at 38 ms median added latency, matching 96% of a two-tier guard-LLM cascade's F1 at 1/385 of its latency with 0% evasion under 13 adversarial transformations; diverting the malicious share cuts production-model token consumption under concurrent flooding with real GCG-suffix payloads by 97.8%; the trained replica agrees with the production model on 92.9% of benign holdout requests, while naive unconditional bait injection collapses to 7.6% and selective camouflaged injection recovers to 88.9%, mapping the recoverable fidelity-traceability frontier; and a loop-trained correction head cuts misrouting of legitimate security research 9x while raising detection F1 to .933.
title: HoneyRoute: Honeypot-Model Routing for Adversarial LLM Serving

title_translated: HoneyRoute：用于对抗性LLM服务的蜜罐-模型路由
summary_translated: 我们提出了HoneyRoute，一种推理服务层，能够检测传入请求是否恶意，若是，则将其路由至专用蜜罐模型，从而在持续收集攻击者交互情报的同时保护生产环境。现有防御方法在模型内存中嵌入陷阱或在协议层重建欺骗，但使服务层仍处于 unprotected 状态，且无法将反馈信息回传至检测系统。HoneyRoute结合了（i）一个流式路由器（冻结的0.8B嵌入主干网络，搭配每个领域的MLP头部），（ii）双实现蜜罐（基于规则/提示工程的代码蜜罐或同家族专用副本），以及（iii）一个分析循环，将捕获的交互转化为攻击者指纹以用于路由器再训练。在生产轨迹和七域攻击语料上，路由器达到F1=0.911，中位延迟增加38毫秒，其性能相当于两层守护LLM级联的96%，但延迟仅为后者的1/385，且在13种对抗变换下零逃逸；将恶意流量引导至蜜罐可使并发洪水攻击中真实GCG后缀负载下的生产模型token消耗减少97.8%；训练后的副本在良性保留请求上与生产模型一致率达92.9%，而朴素无条件诱饵注入降至7.6%，选择性伪装注入恢复至88.9%，映射出可恢复的保真度-可追溯性边界；循环训练的校正头使合法安全研究误分流降低9倍，同时将检测F1提升至0.933。

summary: Modern LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable skills, yet as skill libraries scale to thousands of entries, effective retrieval becomes a bottleneck. Graph-of-Skills (GoS) addresses this challenge by exploiting dependency-aware graph structure for scalable skill retrieval, while SkillDAG further demonstrates that skill graphs can accumulate execution-backed structure online. However, these approaches leave open whether historical execution traces can be systematically distilled into a better retrieval graph that generalizes to unseen tasks. We present Self-Evolving Graph-of-Skills (SE-GoS), a training-free framework that evolves an existing GoS graph from execution traces while preserving the original retrieval pipeline. SE-GoS performs three complementary updates: topology evolution that discovers and prunes skill relationships from execution evidence, edge-weight evolution that reinforces retrieval-relevant relationships based on historical effectiveness, and description evolution that optimizes retrieval-facing skill descriptions using execution feedback. Across three LLMs on SkillsBench, SE-GoS consistently improves task reward while reducing input tokens relative to full skill loading, with gains varying across model families. In a representative setting, one evolution round improves reward from 52.4\% to 59.4\% while reducing input tokens by approximately one-third relative to full skill loading, and the resulting graph transfers to a disjoint held-out split with a 5.4-point improvement over the static GoS baseline. These results show that skill graphs can be improved from execution experience without model training, changes to the retrieval algorithm, or modifications to skill content, turning a static retrieval graph into an evolving retrieval infrastructure.
title: SE-GoS: Self-Evolving Graph-of-Skills for Skill Library at Scale

title_translated: SE-GoS：可自演化技能图谱以实现大规模技能库管理
summary_translated: 现代大语言模型智能体越来越多地依赖可复用的技能，但当技能库扩展到数千项时，有效检索成为瓶颈。技能图谱（GoS）通过利用依赖感知的图结构来实现可扩展的技能检索，而SkillDAG进一步证明技能图可在运行时积累执行支持的结构。然而，这些方法尚未解决历史执行轨迹能否系统性地提炼为更优的检索图并泛化至未见任务的问题。我们提出自演化技能图谱（SE-GoS），一种无需训练的框架，能够在不改变原有检索流程的前提下，从执行轨迹中演化现有的GoS图。SE-GoS执行三项互补更新：拓扑演化（从执行证据中发现并修剪技能关系）、边权重演化（基于历史有效性强化检索相关关系）以及描述演化（利用执行反馈优化面向检索的技能描述）。在SkillsBench上的三个大语言模型测试中，SE-GoS始终在减少输入token的同时提升任务奖励，增益因模型家族而异。在一个代表性设置中，一次演化轮次使奖励从52.4%提升至59.4%，相对于完整加载技能，输入token减少约三分之一，且生成的图在独立保留分割上相比静态GoS基线提升5.4分。结果表明，仅通过执行经验即可改进技能图，无需模型训练、检索算法变更或技能内容修改，将静态检索图转变为动态演化的检索基础设施。

summary: Dynamic layer routing reduces the inference cost of Large Language Models (LLMs) by learning to skip layers for individual tokens. Existing methods, however, treat each routing decision as a local operation conditioned solely on the current hidden state which is a formulation that overlooks the sequential, path-dependent nature of routing across depth: earlier decisions shape the representations seen by downstream routers, and the layer-usage objective couples all decisions jointly. We propose History-Aware Routing (HeRo), a dynamic routing framework that resolves this mismatch by introducing a router memory mechanism to maintain an explicit routing state across model depth. The memory is constructed via linear attention, incrementally aggregating preceding routing scores and their induced residual updates into a compact history representation. At each routed layer, the router conditions jointly on this accumulated state and the current hidden representation to select the executed branch. Instantiated for token-wise FFN routing, HeRo trains only lightweight routers and adapters on a frozen backbone, requiring no modification to pretrained parameters. Across Llama 3.1-8B, Llama 2-7B, and Llama 2-13B, HeRo consistently achieves the highest aggregate performance retention among ten baselines. On Llama 3.1-8B, it bypasses 26.87% of model parameters while achieving 100.24% of dense model performance across seven benchmarks, and retains 97.01% while bypassing 38.82% of model parameters under a tighter computation budget. Ablation studies confirm that removing routing history consistently degrades performance, most notably on multistep reasoning and code generation, validating that explicit routing memory enables more accurate and adaptive dynamic routing than solely conditioning on hidden state.
title: Do Dynamic Routers Need Memory? HeRo: History-Aware Routing for Efficient LLM Inference
