title_translated: 针对隐私保护LLM中嵌入到嵌入混淆的新型语义流形对齐攻击
summary_translated: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）的广泛应用，隐私保护推理对敏感查询变得日益重要。为平衡隐私与效用，一系列轻量级混淆方法被提出，用户在本地将明文嵌入转换为固定的密文嵌入。尽管此类嵌入到嵌入混淆（E2EO）方案在抵御传统词频和嵌入逆向攻击方面表现出较强韧性，但其核心机制仍依赖大规模一对一替换，缺乏密码学保障。本文提出代理流形对齐（PMA），一种针对隐私保护LLM中E2EO的新攻击方法。我们的关键观察是，E2EO方案保留了原始语义结构，因此混淆后的向量流可被视为一种未知分词器语言，其符号即为向量本身。因此，所提出的密文到明文重构攻击可被建模为从未知分词器语言到明文的翻译任务。具体而言，仅通过访问混淆向量流、目标分词器和公开语料库，PMA攻击首先分别使用Word2Vec建模混淆流与公开语料库中的共现模式，构建两个代理向量嵌入；然后基于结构相似性对齐这两个嵌入的底层流形；最后将混淆向量映射回明文。实验结果表明，PMA在明文恢复方面始终优于其他最先进的攻击方法。

summary: Latent visual reasoning aims to perform multimodal reasoning through hidden-state computation rather than explicit textual chains of thought. However, visual information being present in a latent state does not imply that the model actually relies on that state when producing its answer, especially when alternative image-conditioned paths remain available. We introduce \textbf{C}ausal \textbf{V}isual \textbf{R}ecurrent \textbf{R}easoning (CVRR), which preserves pretrained visual competence while making recurrent computation the required image-conditioned path to prediction. CVRR initializes recurrence from the question hidden state after the pretrained vision-language model has incorporated the image, then repeatedly updates this state while re-reading the same fixed visual evidence. Before decoding, visual states and the original multimodal KV cache are removed so that only the final recurrent state carries image-conditioned information to the answer. Across the $V^*$, MMVP, BLINK, and MME-RealWorld-Lite benchmarks, CVRR retains strong performance under this strict interface, while compatible latent reasoners fail to recover comparable visual competence even when retrained under the same constraint. Causal interventions further show that predictions remain sensitive to recurrent content when the question is held fixed, and that persistent visual evidence causally revises the recurrent trajectory. These results distinguish latent informativeness from latent computation that is actually used for prediction.
title: Reason Through the Latent! Making Latent Visual Reasoning Necessary
title_translated: 深入潜层！使潜层视觉推理成为必要
summary_translated: 潜层视觉推理旨在通过隐藏状态计算而非显式的文本思维链来实现多模态推理。然而，视觉信息存在于潜层状态并不意味着模型在生成答案时实际上依赖该状态，尤其当存在其他图像条件路径时。我们引入因果视觉递归推理（CVRR），在保持预训练视觉能力的同时，使递归计算成为预测所需的图像条件路径。CVRR在预训练视觉-语言模型融合图像后，从问题隐藏状态初始化递归过程，随后反复更新该状态并重新读取相同的固定视觉证据。在解码前，移除视觉状态和原始多模态KV缓存，使得只有最终递归状态携带图像条件信息至答案。在V*、MMVP、BLINK和MME-RealWorld-Lite基准测试中，CVRR在严格接口下仍保持强性能，而兼容的潜层推理模型即使在相同约束下重训也无法恢复相当的视觉能力。因果干预进一步表明，当问题固定时，预测仍对递归内容敏感，且持续的视觉证据会因果地修正递归轨迹。这些结果区分了潜层信息丰富性与实际用于预测的潜层计算。

summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) may often look plausible, yet it may not faithfully reflect the model's decision-making process. While methods for measuring the faithfulness of CoTs for textual inputs have been increasingly introduced, using these methods for visual inputs is not straightforward. In this work, we adapt the family of counterfactual methods for measuring CoT faithfulness, namely the Counterfactual Test (CT) and Correlational Counterfactual Test (CCT), to visual inputs, and call them vCT and vCCT, respectively. Using vCT and vCCT, we benchmark eight recent open-source Vision Language Models (VLMs) on two datasets. Our analysis shows that CoTs do not reliably track visual evidence that influences model predictions: they may omit the removed object even when its removal causes a large prediction shift, yet mention it when the shift is small. We further find that Predict-then-Explain explanations align more strongly with perturbation-induced probability shifts than pre-answer CoTs, while binary vCT scores are often nearly saturated. We also include a reconstruction control, in which images pass through the same editing pipeline without object removal, and find that the main object-removal intervention induces larger shifts than reconstruction alone. We construct and release Counter-SNLI-VE and Counter-A-OKVQA, two datasets of image pairs that differ by a single object.
title: Counterfactual Tests for Measuring Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness in Visual Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 用于衡量视觉语言模型思维链忠实性的反事实测试
summary_translated: 思维链（CoT）虽然看起来合理，但未必真实反映模型的决策过程。尽管已有方法用于衡量文本输入下CoT的忠实性，但将其应用于视觉输入并不直接可行。本文将反事实方法家族——反事实测试（CT）和相关反事实测试（CCT）——适配到视觉输入，分别称为vCT和vCCT。利用vCT和vCCT，我们在两个数据集上对八种近期开源视觉语言模型进行了基准测试。分析表明，思维链并不能可靠追踪影响模型预测的视觉证据：当移除物体导致预测大幅变化时，思维链可能忽略该物体；而当变化较小时，反而会提及它。我们还发现，先预测后解释的解释方式比预答案思维链更紧密地与扰动引起的概率变化一致，而二元vCT评分通常接近饱和。此外，我们引入了重构对照实验，即图像经过相同编辑流程但不移除物体，结果发现主要的物体移除干预引起的预测变化大于仅重构带来的变化。我们构建并发布了Counter-SNLI-VE和Counter-A-OKVQA两个图像对数据集，其差异仅在于一个物体。

summary: The In-context learning (ICL) paradigm aids large language models (LLMs) to adapt to new tasks without need for fine-tuning. However, selecting an optimal combination of demonstration examples from a large pool of example subsets is a challenging problem. Existing approaches for selection do not model the complex relationship between ICL samples and downstream LLM performance. They typically perform static task-level selection, choosing subsets once offline, which can fail to generalize to unseen queries. We introduce DearICL (Data Efficient Algorithm for Ranking) ICL samples, a new framework that models demonstration example selection as a subset ranking problem. DearICL employs a non-linear surrogate employing a differentiable sorting objective within a gap-index bandit algorithm. The gap-index based approach enables fine-grained separation of good arms and borderline arms, which is used as an auxiliary objective to train the non-linear surrogate through sufficient sampling of borderline arms, supporting instance-level subset ranking. On exemplar selection benchmarks with open-source LLMs, DearICL achieves 8.08-15.9% accuracy gains over strong linear bandit baselines, with low sample complexity. Code and data: https://github.com/VenkteshV/DearICL.
title: Data Efficient Sample Selection for In-Context Learning
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main track, 22 pages with sample-complexity proof in Appendix;
title_translated: 面向上下文学习的数据高效样本选择
summary_translated: 上下文学习（ICL）范式使大型语言模型（LLMs）能够在无需微调的情况下适应新任务。然而，从大量示例子集中选择最优的演示示例组合是一个具有挑战性的问题。现有选择方法未能建模ICL样本与下游LLM性能之间的复杂关系。它们通常采用静态的任务级选择策略，在离线阶段一次性选定子集，难以泛化到未见过的查询。我们提出DearICL（数据高效排序算法）框架，将演示示例选择建模为子集排序问题。DearICL采用非线性代理，结合可微排序目标与基于差距指数的老虎机算法。基于差距指数的方法能够精细区分优质选项与边缘选项，作为辅助目标通过充分采样边缘选项来训练非线性代理，从而支持实例级别的子集排序。在开源LLM的示例选择基准测试中，DearICL相较于强线性老虎机基线实现了8.08%-15.9%的准确率提升，且样本复杂度低。代码与数据见：https://github.com/VenkteshV/DearICL。

summary: Research teams and organizations often explore unfamiliar free-text collections, from survey comments and reviews to reports and domain documents, before labels, queries or coding schemes exist. At this stage, the first thematic map shapes what users notice, prioritize and carry into downstream analysis, so it should be trusted only insofar as it can be verified. Existing options force a trade-off between scale and verifiability. Qualitative coding preserves evidence but is slow. Search presupposes a query. Clustering and topic models scale but produce labels users must interpret. One-shot large language model (LLM) summaries are fluent yet difficult to reproduce or audit. We present EviMap, an interactive system providing researchers and practitioners with an auditable thematic overview of such corpora. Guided by model-generated context describing the corpus and hypothesized stakeholder concerns, EviMap extracts within-document evidence phrases and organizes them, rather than whole documents, into a three-level map of aspects, groups and fine-grained topics. Embedding-based clustering narrows the search space for finer semantic judgments by the LLM. Each node traces back to supporting phrase spans, so documents link to topics through evidence they contain and users can audit labels against the original text. Users can start from a top-level corpus map, drill into topics, inspect highlighted evidence in original documents, and combine two topics to find documents discussing both. We demonstrate this workflow across six heterogeneous corpora spanning 2,108 to 101,699 documents, with a comparison against flat and hierarchical LLM baselines. By grounding every label in verbatim source spans, EviMap makes a topic map not just readable, but verifiable. Code, demo video, and interactive dashboard are available at https://github.com/zhiyintan/EviMap.
title: EviMap: Evidence-Grounded Hierarchical Topic Maps for Exploring Unlabeled Corpora
comment: Accepted at the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM '26)
title_translated: EviMap：基于证据的层次化主题地图以探索无标签语料库
summary_translated: 研究团队和组织在缺乏标签、查询或编码方案的情况下，常需探索自由文本集合，如调查评论、用户评价、报告和领域文档。在此阶段，首个主题图谱决定了用户注意、优先和带入后续分析的内容，因此必须具备可验证性。现有方法在规模与可验证性之间存在权衡：定性编码虽保留证据但效率低；搜索依赖于查询；聚类与主题模型可扩展但生成的标签需用户解读；单次大语言模型（LLM）摘要流畅但难以复现或审计。我们提出EviMap，一种交互式系统，为研究人员和实践者提供可审计的主题概览。在模型生成的上下文描述和假设利益相关方关切的引导下，EviMap提取文档内的证据短语，并将其组织成三级结构：方面、组别和细粒度主题，而非整篇文档。基于嵌入的聚类缩小了LLM进行细粒度语义判断的搜索空间。每个节点均可追溯至支持的原文片段，文档通过其所含证据链接至主题，用户可针对原始文本审计标签。用户可从顶层语料图开始，深入主题，检查原始文档中的高亮证据，并合并两个主题以查找同时讨论两者的文档。我们在六个异构语料库（涵盖2,108至101,699篇文档）上展示了该工作流，并与扁平及层次化的LLM基线进行对比。通过将每个标签都锚定在原文片段上，EviMap使主题图谱不仅可读，而且可验证。代码、演示视频和交互仪表板可在 https://github.com/zhiyintan/EviMap 获取。

summary: Although professional workflows leverage large language models widely, the interpretation for auditing unconstrained free-text generation is usually intractable if such generation demands legal, operational or financial workflow. We hereby demonstrate a text based system called SerenAI - inspired by world-models, it is a state transition system that outputs verifiable predictions rather than merely text: Provided with a description of the environment, state, and actions, the generated output contains 4 items: causal deltas that causally effect the given state, a next state that can logically follow from the given state and action, a validity reward, and a termination signal. For the released proto-model, we employ 2 steps of adaptation training, namely parameter efficient fine-tuning followed by verifier based RL over 50,000 exampled cause and effects in 12 environments spanning 10 reasoning domains. Compared to an initial internal evaluation of an 8B open-weight baseline, SerenAI increased JSON validity from 85.0% to 93.2%, schema validity from 55.0% to 84.0%, exact structured-output match from 0.0% to 41.5%, causal-delta exact match from 0.0% to 41.5%, resulting-state exact match from 0.0% to 42.0%, reward exact match from 1.0% to 80.5%, and termination exact match from 38.0% to 81.5%. These support the narrower claim that verifier-compatible adaptation can improve structured transition prediction. They do not yet establish legal-grade reliability. Accordingly, the paper also specifies a validation protocol for evidence-grounded legal workflows, calibration, human oversight, and sovereign on-premise deployment.
title: SerenAI: State-transition system inspired by text-based world AI models
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables
title_translated: SerenAI：受基于文本的世界模型启发的状态转移系统
summary_translated: 尽管专业工作流程广泛使用大型语言模型，但在法律、运营或财务等需要严格审计的场景中，对不受约束的自由文本生成的解释通常难以处理。为此，我们展示了一种名为SerenAI的基于文本的系统——受世界模型启发，它是一个状态转移系统，输出的是可验证的预测而非单纯文本。给定环境、状态和动作描述后，生成输出包含四项内容：因果变化量（causal deltas）、可逻辑推导出的下一状态、有效性奖励以及终止信号。对于发布的原型模型，我们采用了两步适应训练：首先是参数高效的微调，然后是在12个环境、10个推理领域中共50,000个因果案例上的基于验证器的强化学习。相比初始内部评估的8B开源基线模型，SerenAI显著提升了各项指标：JSON有效性从85.0%提升至93.2%，模式有效性从55.0%提升至84.0%，精确结构化输出匹配率从0.0%升至41.5%，因果变化量精确匹配率从0.0%升至41.5%，下一状态精确匹配率从0.0%升至42.0%，奖励精确匹配率从1.0%升至80.5%，终止信号精确匹配率从38.0%升至81.5%。这些结果支持了‘验证器兼容的适应能改善结构化状态转移预测’这一较窄主张，但尚未达到法律级可靠性。因此，论文还提出了针对证据基础法律工作流的验证协议，包括校准、人工监督和主权本地部署。

summary: Recent studies report that automated red-teaming finds more vulnerabilities, at lower cost, than human red-teaming on standard AI safety benchmarks, and some read this as evidence that human evaluators are becoming dispensable. The comparison measures one thing and the conclusion claims another. A benchmark measures how thoroughly an attacker searches a predefined set of harms, fixed in advance by the developers, and a harm left out of that set is invisible to any attacker working inside it, automated or not. The same blind spot appeared in academic cryptography and in clinical drug trials, where an evaluation that was internally valid stayed silent about the population it was never pointed at. We call the AI-safety version the \emph{threat-model coverage gap}, and find that it persists in a current open-weight model, where harms surface in non-English prompts that English benchmarks miss. Closing it requires evaluators whose deployment context differs from the developers'. The case for those evaluators is methodological, grounded in coverage, and the existing evaluation frame is unlikely to produce them on its own.
title: A Translational Note on AI Safety Evaluation
comment: Accepted for the 2nd Workshop on Safe AI at UAI (SafeAI 2026). 6 pages
title_translated: 关于人工智能安全评估的一则翻译笔记
summary_translated: 近期研究表明，自动化红队测试在标准AI安全基准上比人工红队测试发现了更多漏洞，且成本更低，一些人据此认为人类评估者正变得可有可无。然而，这种比较测量的是攻击者对开发者预先设定的伤害集合的覆盖程度，而未被纳入该集合的伤害对任何在该框架内工作的攻击者（无论自动化与否）都是不可见的。这一盲点曾在学术密码学和临床药物试验中出现过，当时评估虽内部有效，却对从未指向的人群保持沉默。我们称AI安全领域的这一现象为‘威胁模型覆盖缺口’，并在当前一个开放权重模型中发现，非英文提示中暴露的伤害被英文基准所遗漏。要弥补这一缺口，需要评估者部署环境与开发者不同。这一主张具有方法论基础，根植于覆盖范围，而现有的评估框架自身不太可能产生此类评估者。

summary: Enterprise AI is evolving into an Enterprise Operating System where autonomous AI agents can plan, reason, use memory, invoke tools, execute workflows, and collaborate with other agents. This shift creates a new governance challenge: existing authorization, security, guardrails, and compliance mechanisms are fragmented and are not designed to govern autonomous AI as a unified system.   This paper introduces the Unified Policy Architecture (UPA), a governance architecture for Enterprise AI Operating Systems. UPA provides a unified policy model for governing AI and agents, tools, workflows, memory, enterprise resources, and agent-to-agent interactions and enterprise business rules. It extends policy control beyond authorisation to include runtime obligations, human approvals, compliance, audit evidence, and governance evaluation.   We present UPA's governance model, declarative policy language foundations, policy evaluation semantics, extensible plugins, industry policy packs, and an evaluation framework for enterprise governance. We also identify extensions for multi-agent coordination, provenance-aware policies, and stateful runtime governance. UPA provides a foundation for building secure, accountable, and governable Enterprise Operating Systems for autonomous AI.
title: A Unified Policy Architecture (UPA): The Governance Kernel for Enterprise AI Operating Systems
comment: 58 pages, 6 figures. Includes appendices with the DGPL grammar, SID registry, EAGBench benchmark specification, extended governance models, and policy examples
title_translated: 统一策略架构（UPA）：企业AI操作系统中的治理核心
summary_translated: 企业AI正演变为一个企业操作系统，其中自主AI代理能够规划、推理、使用记忆、调用工具、执行工作流，并与其他代理协作。这一转变带来了新的治理挑战：现有的授权、安全、护栏和合规机制分散且未针对作为统一系统的自主AI进行设计。本文提出了统一策略架构（UPA），这是一种面向企业AI操作系统的治理架构。UPA为治理AI、代理、工具、工作流、记忆、企业资源、代理间交互及企业业务规则提供了一个统一的策略模型。它将策略控制扩展至授权之外，涵盖运行时义务、人工审批、合规性、审计证据和治理评估。我们展示了UPA的治理模型、声明式策略语言基础、策略评估语义、可扩展插件、行业策略包以及企业治理的评估框架。同时，我们识别了多智能体协调、溯源感知策略和有状态运行时治理的扩展方向。UPA为构建安全、可问责且可治理的自主AI企业操作系统奠定了基础。

summary: Recursive Super-Resolution (SR) extends fixed-scale SR to extreme magnification by repeatedly feeding predictions back into the same model, analogous to zooming an image repeatedly. However, ground truth availability at every scale, especially at depth, remains challenging as the required source resolution grows geometrically, leaving deeper predictions unsupervised. We present OracleZoom, an on-policy distillation-inspired, reference-constrained framework that trains on its trajectory while carrying the last ground-truth evidence beyond the supervision boundary. Direct and cross-scale supervision constrain verifiable content, while a no-reference quality objective guides unresolved fine-scale detail. A KL-constrained pretrained latent prior limits quality-driven drift, while EMA consistency stabilizes the supervision boundary. Across seven datasets, OracleZoom achieves the state-of-the-art SR quality across zooming scales, averaging 0.713 CLIPIQA, with larger gains on deeper scales, while significantly reducing hallucinations. Code, data, and models are available at https://dipta007.github.io/OracleZoom/ .
title: OracleZoom: On-Policy Self-Distillation Inspired Reference-Constrained Recursive Image Super Resolution
title_translated: OracleZoom：受参考约束的递归图像超分辨率的在策略自蒸馏方法
summary_translated: 递归超分辨率（SR）通过反复将预测结果反馈给同一模型，将固定尺度的SR扩展到极端放大倍数，类似于反复缩放图像。然而，在每一尺度上获取真实标签仍具挑战性，尤其是深层尺度，因为所需源分辨率呈几何级增长，导致更深的预测缺乏监督。我们提出OracleZoom，一种受在策略自蒸馏启发、具有参考约束的框架，该框架在训练过程中保留超出监督边界的最后真实证据。直接和跨尺度监督约束可验证内容，而无参考质量目标则引导未解决的细粒度细节。基于KL约束的预训练潜在先验限制了质量驱动的偏差，EMA一致性稳定了监督边界。在七个数据集上，OracleZoom在所有缩放尺度上均达到最先进的SR质量，平均CLIPIQA为0.713，深层尺度提升更显著，同时显著减少了幻觉现象。代码、数据和模型可在https://dipta007.github.io/OracleZoom/ 获取。

summary: To solve the fractional knapsack problem, Dantzig's greedy rule orders items according to their value-to-cost ratio. This ordering introduces priority issues. An arbitrarily small perturbation to the input can change the allocation if the budget is exhausted between two items with very similar ratios. To mitigate that problem, we introduce a two-stage rule. We group items sharing attributes within a radius $δ$. These groups are then evaluated in descending order of ratio, and divide their group's budget share without further ranking. Consider a group featuring an aggregate capacity $U_G$, unit costs contained in $[w^-,w^+]$, and a representative value $\widehat{v}$. The group's loss compared to the exact optimum is bounded by $\widehat{v}\, U_G\frac{w^+-w^-}{w^++w^-}+\varepsilon_v U_G$, in which $\varepsilon_v$ limits the group's internal value variation. Moreover, for any group size, this harmonic factor remains tight. The overall loss becomes restricted to the single budget-binding group whenever the grouping remains order-compatible; thus, groups containing at most $K$ items suffer a per-item loss of $\mathcal{O}(K/n)$. Should group ratio intervals exhibit an overlap of at most $ω$, an additive term $ωC$ degrades this bound. Within the separation margin between adjacent groups, the grouped allocation remains Lipschitz continuous with respect to cost data, exhibiting a modulus of $\frac{K}{w_{\min}}$. Computing this allocation takes $\mathcal{O}(n+m\log m+|Γ|\log|Γ|)$ time given $m$ groups and a boundary group $Γ$. Alternatively, the time complexity drops to $\mathcal{O}(n+m\log m)$ if a linear-time selection method identifies the boundary group's allocation.
title: A Group-Based Resource Allocation Model for the Fractional Knapsack Problem
title_translated: 基于分组的分数背包问题资源分配模型
summary_translated:
为解决分数背包问题，Dantzig的贪心规则根据物品的价值与成本比进行排序。这种排序引入了优先级问题：输入的微小扰动可能导致预算在两个价值比非常接近的物品之间耗尽，从而改变分配结果。为缓解此问题，我们提出一种两阶段规则。我们将属性在半径δ内的物品分组，然后按比值降序评估各组，并在不进一步排序的情况下分配组内预算份额。考虑一个具有总容量$U_G$、单位成本位于$[w^-,w^+]$区间、代表性价值$\ ar{v}$的组，其相对于精确最优解的损失被限定为$\ ar{v}
 U_G\frac{w^+-w^-}{w^++w^-}+\varepsilon_v U_G$，其中$\ ar{v}$限制组内价值变化。此外，对于任意组大小，该调和因子保持紧致。当分组保持顺序兼容时，整体损失仅受限于单一预算绑定组；因此，每组最多包含$K$个物品时，每个物品的损失为$\\mathcal{O}(K/n)$。若组比值区间重叠不超过$ω$，则附加项$ωC$会降低该界。在相邻组之间的分离裕度内，分组分配对成本数据保持Lipschitz连续，模为$ rac{K}{w_{\min}}$。给定$m$个组和边界组$Γ$，计算该分配的时间复杂度为$\\mathcal{O}(n+m\log m+|Γ|\log|Γ|)$；若采用线性时间选择法确定边界组的分配，则时间复杂度降至$\\mathcal{O}(n+m\log m)$。

summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) across multiple domains can broaden the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet joint training often degrades individual-domain performance and can destabilize optimization. Existing work typically diagnoses such interference from a single-step view using first-order gradient alignment or curvature-based proxies. We show that this view can miss a critical form of sequential interference: same-point domain gradients may remain nearly orthogonal even when consecutive realized updates partially reverse one another in output space. We further show that consecutive token log-probability footprints recover this interaction directly from adjacent checkpoints as a local second-order interaction in output space, without explicitly reconstructing same-step curvature. Building on this insight, we propose OSOL, which designates a focus domain at each iteration, uses the preceding checkpoint footprint to rank token-level rebound risk, and applies a drift-ranked, adaptively scaled correction within the standard GRPO update. Our analysis shows that this correction suppresses the targeted cross-step output backtracking component. Controlled studies further show that cross-step backtracking is more strongly associated with subsequent task damage than same-point gradient diagnostics, while the preceding footprint ranks future rebound risk more accurately than Hessian-based proxies. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, OSOL reaches a domain-macro average of 0.4822, improving by 5.7% over the strongest compared baseline, without explicit higher-order differentiation.
title: One Step, One Lead: Mitigating Higher-Order Interference in Multi-Domain Reinforcement Learning via Cross-Step Control
title_translated: 一步一领：通过跨步控制缓解多领域强化学习中的高阶干扰
summary_translated: 在多个领域中进行强化学习（RL）可以拓展大型语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力，但联合训练常导致单个领域的性能下降并可能使优化过程不稳定。现有研究通常从单步视角出发，利用一阶梯度对齐或基于曲率的代理来诊断此类干扰。我们发现，这种视角可能遗漏一种关键的序列干扰：即使连续实现的更新在输出空间中部分相互抵消，相同位置的领域梯度仍可能几乎正交。我们进一步表明，连续标记的概率足迹能直接从相邻检查点恢复这种相互作用，作为输出空间中的局部二阶交互，无需显式重构同步曲率。基于此洞察，我们提出OSOL，该方法在每次迭代中指定一个关注领域，利用前一检查点的足迹对token级反弹风险进行排序，并在标准GRPO更新中应用基于漂移排序、自适应缩放的修正。分析表明，该修正抑制了目标跨步输出回溯成分。受控实验进一步显示，跨步回溯与后续任务损害的相关性更强，且前一足迹对未来的反弹风险预测优于Hessian基代理。在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，OSOL达到领域宏观平均0.4822，相比最强基线提升5.7%，且无需显式高阶微分。

summary: Randomized benchmarking can hide classical temporal correlations because its Clifford-twirled response is even in the noise phase. For a stationary symmetric telegraph fluctuator, we show that continuous evolution and independent stationary resets at slot boundaries yield identical mean responses for arbitrary fixed idle modulations. We construct an eight-setting phase-cycle measurement of the connected sine-phase covariance under ideal Clifford twirling and classical idle dephasing. This observable vanishes for independent slot noise and fixed detuning without a weak-phase or Gaussian approximation. A closed telegraph response, independent circuit calculations and 800 simulation trials validate the construction and quantify the empirical coverage of a paired bootstrap estimator. A separate conservative confidence set states its finite-sample assumptions. Two acquisitions on an IBM processor compare engineered shared-sign and independently reset phases with identical marginals. Their primary contrasts are 0.254 and 0.211, with empirical 95% intervals [0.177, 0.331] and [0.136, 0.285], respectively; all negative-control intervals include zero. At equal shot and sensingwindow budgets, an ideal Ramsey/echo estimator is more precise in every tested class. The result supplies an explicit connection between a benchmarking identifiability limitation and a controlled correlation measurement. No native or quantum-memory detection is claimed.
title: Phase-cycled randomized benchmarking of quantum processors: recovering hidden classical noise correlations
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Code and data: this https URL
title_translated: 量子处理器的相位循环随机基准测试：恢复隐藏的经典噪声相关性
summary_translated: 随机基准测试可能掩盖经典时间相关性，因为其Clifford-twirled响应在噪声相位上是偶函数。对于一个平稳对称电报涨落器，我们证明连续演化与在槽边界独立的平稳重置会产生任意固定空闲调制下的相同平均响应。我们构建了一种八设置相位循环测量，用于理想Clifford扭曲和经典空闲去相位下的连接正弦相位协方差。该可观测量在独立槽噪声和固定失谐下为零，无需弱相位或高斯近似。闭合电报响应、独立电路计算和800次模拟试验验证了该构造，并量化了配对Bootstrap估计器的经验覆盖范围。一个独立的保守置信集陈述了其有限样本假设。在IBM处理器上的两次采集比较了工程化的共享符号相位与独立重置相位，两者边际相同。它们的主要对比值分别为0.254和0.211，经验95%置信区间分别为[0.177, 0.331]和[0.136, 0.285]；所有负控制区间的置信区间均包含零。在相等的采样次数和传感窗口预算下，理想Ramsey/echo估计器在所有测试类别中均更精确。该结果建立了基准测试可辨识性局限与受控相关性测量之间的明确联系。未声称存在原生或量子内存检测。

summary: Graph-agentic retrieval-augmented generation combines structured evidence with adaptive controllers that can plan retrieval, traverse relations, verify intermediate claims, delegate subtasks, and use tools. This combination is useful when answers depend on relations across documents, entities, time, or institutions, but it also creates coupled failure paths: a defect in graph construction can become retrieved evidence, alter later control decisions, and propagate toward a consequential outcome. We examine how such systems should be designed and evaluated for social-good settings in which freshness, authorization, traceability, oversight, and recourse matter alongside answer quality. We organize the literature by graph substrate, graph lifecycle, agent function, coordination pattern, and authority boundary, and distinguish graph-based retrieval from observation-dependent graph control. We then synthesize reported risks as an evidence-to-action failure chain and propose an assurance-by-construction blueprint comprising five interface contracts for evidence, retrieval, reasoning, capability and delegation, and outcome. These contracts make provenance, temporal validity, authorization, uncertainty, and recoverability explicit at system boundaries. An illustrative public-benefit information design shows how the framework constrains graph structure, permissions, abstention, and operating authority. Finally, we derive an evaluation agenda spanning graph assertions, trajectories, claims, coordination, and outcomes.
title: Building Trustworthy Graph-Agentic RAG for Social Good: Architectures, Failure Propagation, and Assurance by Construction
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures
title_translated: 构建可信的图智能体RAG以造福社会：架构、故障传播与构建保障
summary_translated: 图智能体检索增强生成结合了结构化证据与自适应控制器，能够规划检索、遍历关系、验证中间主张、委派子任务并使用工具。当答案依赖于文档间、实体间、时间或机构间的关系时，这种组合非常有用，但也带来了耦合的故障路径：图构建中的缺陷可能成为检索证据，影响后续控制决策，并向最终结果传播。我们探讨了在关注新鲜度、授权、可追溯性、监督和救济权的社会公益场景中，此类系统应如何设计与评估。我们按图基础、图生命周期、代理功能、协调模式和权限边界对文献进行组织，并区分基于图的检索与依赖观测的图控制。随后，我们将报告的风险归纳为从证据到行动的故障链，并提出一种通过构建实现保障的蓝图，包含五个接口契约：证据、检索、推理、能力与委派、结果。这些契约在系统边界上明确体现了来源、时间有效性、授权、不确定性与可恢复性。一个示例性的公共利益信息设计展示了该框架如何约束图结构、权限、回避行为和操作权限。最后，我们提出了涵盖图断言、轨迹、主张、协调与结果的评估议程。

summary: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) scoresmultiple completions per prompt using automatic verifiers. Analysesbased on independent verifier errors may overlook dependence associatedwith shared answer formats. We investigate this dependence in24,998 groups of eight completions generated by Qwen2.5-1.5B onMATH, GSM8K, and DeepMath-103K. We estimate a pooled within-groupverifier-error correlation of 0.530 (95% confidence interval:0.500--0.560). Under an exchangeable-error model, this correspondsto a design-effect-adjusted effective sample size of 1.70 for aneight-completion group. Dependence varies substantially across answerforms: fractions, radicals, symbolic expressions, and intervals exhibitstronger clustering than unit annotations and percent signs. Replayinggroup-relative advantages across four rule-based verifier configurationsidentifies at least one advantage-sign disagreement in up to 0.83% ofgroups. Because a group is repeated sampling for one prompt, thiswithin-group clustering may reflect shared prompt difficulty as well asshared answer form, and we do not attempt to separate the two here.Unlike studies of correlated judgments across multiple evaluators, ouranalysis examines dependence across completions scored by the sameverifier. These findings motivate prompt- and answer-form-aware analysesof verifier noise rather than characterizations based solely onaggregate error rates.
title: Are Verifier Errors Independent Within a GRPO Group? Evidence from Qwen2.5 Rollouts
comment: 10pages, 4 figures, code and data in this https URL
title_translated: 在GRPO组内验证器错误是否独立？来自Qwen2.5部署的证据
summary_translated: 基于群体的强化学习结合可验证奖励（RLVR）使用自动验证器对每个提示的多个完成结果进行评分。基于验证器错误独立性的分析可能忽略与共享答案格式相关的依赖性。我们研究了在MATH、GSM8K和DeepMath-103K数据集上由Qwen2.5-1.5B生成的24,998个八完成项组中的这种依赖性。我们估计组内验证器错误的相关系数为0.530（95%置信区间：0.500–0.560）。在交换性误差模型下，这对应于一个八完成项组的有效样本量为1.70。依赖性在不同答案形式间差异显著：分数、根式、符号表达式和区间表现出更强的聚类，而单位标注和百分号则较弱。通过在四种基于规则的验证器配置下重放组内优势，发现最多有0.83%的组存在至少一次优势符号不一致。由于一组是针对同一提示的重复采样，这种组内聚类可能反映了共享的提示难度以及共享的答案格式，本文未尝试分离两者。不同于跨多个评估者相关判断的研究，我们的分析考察的是由同一验证器评分的完成项之间的依赖性。这些发现促使我们采用对提示和答案格式敏感的验证器噪声分析，而非仅基于整体错误率的刻画。

summary: The rapid growth of LLM-generated code increases software complexity and the maintenance burden on engineers. While LLMs offer a potential automated alternative, this structural complexity hinders their ability to manage codebases directly. We introduce the Provable Representation Of Original Functionality (PROOF), which manages codebases indirectly via structured specifications. To enable full-lifecycle codebase management strictly through these specifications, PROOF abstracts codebase topology into a hierarchical natural-language representation. To establish absolute trust, the system proves semantic equivalence by reconstructing source code exclusively from this specification. This verified foundation drives maintenance requests, executing code modifications while synchronously updating itself to prevent semantic drift. Experiments on real-world repositories confirm the effectiveness of these specifications.
title: From Reading Code to Reading Spec: A Verified Layer for LLM-Driven Codebase Maintenance
title_translated: 从阅读代码到阅读规范：面向LLM驱动代码库维护的可验证层
summary_translated: LLM生成代码的快速增长增加了软件复杂性，也加重了工程师的维护负担。尽管LLM提供了潜在的自动化替代方案，但其结构性复杂性阻碍了它们直接管理代码库的能力。我们引入了原始功能的可证明表示（PROOF），通过结构化规范间接管理代码库。为了实现完全生命周期的代码库管理，PROOF将代码库拓扑抽象为分层的自然语言表示。为建立绝对信任，系统通过仅从该规范重建源代码来证明语义等价性。这一可验证基础驱动维护请求，在执行代码修改的同时同步自我更新，防止语义漂移。在真实世界仓库上的实验验证了这些规范的有效性。

summary: A query-oblivious coreset for a softmax-attention head is a subset $S$ of the key--value pairs such that attention computed from $S$ alone is within $\varepsilon$ of the full output, in $\ell_2$, simultaneously for every query in a ball. Liberty, Andoni and Kleiner proved that unweighted coresets of size $O(\sqrt d\,e^{ρ+\frac12\logρ+o(\log\logρ)}/\varepsilon)$ exist, $ρ$ being the query radius times the centred key radius, against a lower bound $Ω(\sqrt d\,e^ρ/\varepsilon)$, and conjectured that closing the gap needs new techniques. We show it does not. A spherical lift of both balls into one exponential-kernel instance lets the chaining bound of Bozzai and Rothvoss apply directly, and Chevet's inequality splits key from value dimension: unweighted coresets of size $O(e^ρ(\sqrt{d_v}+\sqrt{d_k\log(1+ρ)})/\varepsilon)$ exist and are computable in randomised polynomial time, the first with a whole-ball guarantee at the existential size up to $\sqrt{\log(1+ρ)}$. A dimension-free sampling cap $O(e^{2ρ}/\varepsilon^{2})$ completes the envelope. In fixed dimension the logarithm disappears: completing the key ball to a sphere makes the kernel an unweighted Gaussian one, so Tai's diameter-free bound gives $O_{d_k,d_v}(e^ρ/\varepsilon)$, ruling out a matching logarithmic lower bound there and answering the Gaussian-restriction case of a question of Bozzai and Rothvoss for the exponential and Hellinger kernels. We restate the Liberty--Andoni--Kleiner bound in the centred convention with a full proof, and show that the one-way communication bounds of Chen et al.\ transfer to query-oblivious coresets, where for $\varepsilon\ll e^{-ρ}$ they are the strongest floors known. The dimensional factor is the price of one signing for all queries: for a single query the discrepancy is $O(e^ρ)$, dimension-free.
title: Query-Oblivious Coresets for Softmax Attention: Improved Bounds and Efficient Constructions
title_translated: 查询无关的核集合用于Softmax注意力：改进的界与高效构造
summary_translated: 对于Softmax注意力头的查询无关核集合，是指一组键值对子集S，使得仅从S计算的注意力在ℓ₂范数上对球体内任意查询都与完整输出相差不超过ε。Liberty、Andoni和Kleiner证明了无权重核集合大小为O(√d·e^(ρ + ½logρ + o(log log ρ))/ε)，其中ρ为查询半径与中心键半径的乘积，且存在Ω(√d·e^ρ/ε)的下界，并推测填补差距需要新方法。我们表明并非如此。通过将两个球体提升至单一指数核实例，可直接应用Bozzai和Rothvoss的链式界，再利用Chevet不等式分离键与值维度：存在大小为O(e^ρ(√dv + √(dk log(1+ρ)))/ε)的无权重核集合，且可在随机多项式时间内计算，这是首个在存在性规模上达到√log(1+ρ)全球保证的构造。一个无维度采样上限O(e^(2ρ)/ε²)完成了整体包络。在固定维度下，对数项消失：将键球补全为球面使核变为无权重高斯核，因此Tai的直径无关界给出O_{dk,dv}(e^ρ/ε)，排除了该区域匹配的对数下界，并回答了Bozzai和Rothvoss关于指数核与Hellinger核的高斯限制情形的问题。我们以中心化约定重新表述Liberty–Andoni–Kleiner界并提供完整证明，还表明Chen等人的一维通信界可转移至查询无关核集合，在ε≪e^(-ρ)时为已知最强下界。维度因子是为所有查询统一签名所付出的代价：对单个查询，偏差为O(e^ρ)，与维度无关。

summary: While deep research systems address interactive information-seeking needs impressively, their real-world deployments face latency and resource-consumption challenges. We present FrankenReport, an interface for long-form knowledge-seeking report generation that supports adaptive early exiting per section: it evaluates intermediate outputs during generation and predicts whether further targeted computation will yield significant quality gains. In a simulation study, FrankenReport outperforms random allocation baselines by a large margin (up to 4x) under low budgets and smoothly recovers full-pipeline quality as the budget grows, showing that future quality gains are predictable from intermediate drafts. Through experiments and user studies, we further show that despite varying preferences across users and topics, FrankenReport adapts to simple, natural user feedback as efficiently as methods requiring much costlier supervision such as generated drafts and explicit rationales.
title: FrankenReport: Early Exiting in Long-Form Generation Using Expected Value of Computation
comment: 23 pages, 16 figures
title_translated: FrankenReport：基于计算期望价值的长篇生成早期退出
summary_translated: 虽然深度研究系统在应对交互式信息获取需求方面表现卓越，但其实际部署面临延迟和资源消耗挑战。我们提出FrankenReport，一种支持按章节自适应早期退出的长篇知识探索报告生成界面：它在生成过程中评估中间输出，并预测进一步针对性计算是否会带来显著质量提升。在模拟研究中，FrankenReport在低预算下远超随机分配基线（最高达4倍），且随着预算增加平滑恢复完整流水线的质量，表明未来质量提升可从中间草稿中预测。通过实验和用户研究，我们进一步证明，尽管用户和主题偏好各异，FrankenReport仍能像需要昂贵监督的方法（如生成草稿和显式理由）一样高效地适应简单自然的用户反馈。

summary: Self-supervised sign language representation learning must model two properties not central to natural-image SSL: signs are produced by a small set of anatomically distinct articulators, and their meaning depends on the temporal organisation of those articulators. We introduce SignDino, a self-supervised sign-video encoder that moves the DINOv3 student--teacher recipe from the spatial domain of image crops to the temporal domain of tracked sign streams. Each video is decomposed into left-hand, right-hand, and face streams by a detector-first YOLOv8n+ByteTrack pipeline. A frozen DINOv3 ViT-B/16 embeds each per-frame anatomical crop, while lightweight temporal Transformers, not the image backbone, form the student and EMA teacher. They are trained by temporal DINO self-distillation, frame-level masked-token prediction in the style of iBOT, KoLeo feature spreading, and Gram anchoring of the frame-to-frame similarity structure. This design keeps strong image-level visual primitives fixed and learns only how articulator states evolve across time. We evaluate on sign-to-English translation, isolated sign recognition, and fingerspelling detection benchmarks. Across these tasks, SignDino provides a strong public self-supervised representation and shows competitive or state-of-the-art performance under matched downstream evaluation.
title: SignDino: Self-Supervised Sign Language Representation Learning via Temporal-Axis Self-Distillation
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures
title_translated: SignDino：通过时间轴自蒸馏实现自监督手语表征学习
summary_translated: 自监督手语表征学习必须建模两个在自然图像自监督学习中不占核心地位的特性：手语由少数解剖结构分明的发音器官产生，且其意义取决于这些器官的时间组织。我们提出SignDino，一种将DINOv3学生-教师范式从图像块的空间域迁移至追踪手语流的时间域的自监督手语视频编码器。每个视频通过检测优先的YOLOv8n+ByteTrack流水线分解为左手、右手和面部流。冻结的DINOv3 ViT-B/16对每个帧的解剖区域进行嵌入，而轻量级的时间Transformer（而非图像主干）作为学生和EMA教师。它们通过时间域DINO自蒸馏、类iBOT的帧级掩码标记预测、KoLeo特征扩散以及帧间相似性结构的Gram锚定进行训练。该设计保持强图像级视觉原语不变，仅学习发音器官状态随时间的演变。我们在手语到英文翻译、孤立手语识别和手指拼写检测基准上进行了评估。在这些任务中，SignDino提供了强大的公开自监督表征，并在匹配的下游评估中表现出竞争性或最先进的性能。

summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) perform strongly on general visual understanding tasks such as visual question answering, yet they often struggle with a basic comparative skill: identifying what has changed between two similar images. We introduce VDiff-Bench, a challenging multiple-choice benchmark for fine-grained Image Difference Identification. VDiff-Bench contains 1,756 four-way questions over image pairs and covers 10 change categories: position, motion, regional image color, overall image color, appearance/disappearance, noise/resolution, texture, substitution/size, OCR/text, and illumination. Each question corresponds to two image inputs with 4 choices: the true difference, two hard negative descriptions, and a "no difference" distractor. To make the task challenging, we specifically curate ground-truth-conditioned negatives that require models to distinguish the actual change from nearby semantic alternatives. Experiments with 11 state-of-the-art open- and closed-source MLLMs show that fine-grained visual comparison remains brittle: models exhibit uneven performance across sources and change categories, with persistent failures on subtle low-level changes like noises and textures. For instance, three 7-8B-scale open-source MLLMs score 52.5-70.6% on semantic changes but only 8.7-33.3% on low-level changes like noise and texture, falsely assuming no changes between two image inputs. Surprisingly, despite strong performance of other closed-source commercial models, Grok 4.3 demonstrate remarkable performance drop on identifying noise and texture differences between images, falling significantly behind large open-source models like Kimi K2.5 and K3. Overall, VDiff-Bench provides a targeted diagnostic for evaluating comparative visual understanding in MLLMs, exposing failures that are not captured by standard single-image vision-language tasks.
title: VDiff-Bench: A Challenging Benchmark for Fine-Grained Image Difference Identification
title_translated: VDiff-Bench：细粒度图像差异识别的挑战性基准
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉问答等通用视觉理解任务中表现强劲，但在基本的比较能力——识别两张相似图像之间的变化——上常表现不佳。我们引入VDiff-Bench，一个用于细粒度图像差异识别的挑战性多项选择基准。VDiff-Bench包含1,756个四选一的问题，覆盖10种变化类别：位置、运动、局部图像颜色、整体图像颜色、外观/消失、噪声/分辨率、纹理、替换/大小、OCR/文本和光照。每个问题对应两幅图像输入和四个选项：真实差异、两个困难负例描述和一个“无差异”干扰项。为使任务更具挑战性，我们特别构建了基于真实差异条件的负样本，要求模型区分实际变化与邻近语义替代。对11个最先进的开源与闭源MLLMs的实验表明，细粒度视觉比较仍然脆弱：模型在不同来源和变化类别间表现不均，对细微低层变化（如噪声和纹理）存在持续失败。例如，三个规模为7-8B的开源MLLMs在语义变化上的得分达52.5%-70.6%，但在噪声和纹理等低层变化上仅得8.7%-33.3%，错误地认为两幅图像无变化。令人惊讶的是，尽管其他闭源商业模型表现良好，Grok 4.3在识别图像间的噪声和纹理差异时表现出显著性能下降，远落后于Kimi K2.5和K3等大型开源模型。总体而言，VDiff-Bench为评估MLLMs的比较性视觉理解提供了一个针对性诊断工具，揭示了标准单图像视觉-语言任务无法捕捉的失败模式。

summary: Data policies for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) determine which rollouts are used, how strongly they are weighted, and which domains contribute to subsequent training batches. We introduce DataFlex-RL, an evaluation platform for comparing these choices under a common GRPO recipe. Our primary experiment evaluates 13 configurations across 12 matched seeds using Qwen2.5-7B-Base and 12 mathematics, logic, and science benchmarks. Uniform GRPO improves the domain-balanced average accuracy by 7.76 percentage points over the untrained checkpoint. None of the eight rollout-selection or reweighting methods achieves a paired 95% confidence interval that excludes zero relative to uniform sampling, and none of the three adaptive mixtures outperforms a fixed equal mixture at the same level of precision. A corrected 12-seed extension on Llama-3.1-8B-Base places the additional methods on the same score scale as the original controls, but does not reveal a consistent winner in terms of observed mean performance. We also quantify evaluation sensitivity by rescoring nine Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct runs using a math-heavy six-benchmark summary, consisting of five mathematics benchmarks and GPQA-Diamond but no logic benchmark, and comparing it with the domain-balanced 12-benchmark summary. The resulting rankings are negatively correlated, with a correlation coefficient of -0.33, whereas summaries that retain all 12 benchmarks largely agree. Across the controlled settings studied here, changing the data policy measurably changes the training process but does not produce a reproducible improvement over uniform training.
title: DataFlex-RL: An Evaluation Platform for RLVR Data Policies
title_translated: DataFlex-RL：强化学习可验证奖励数据策略的评估平台
summary_translated: 强化学习中可验证奖励（RLVR）的数据策略决定了使用哪些轨迹、如何加权以及哪些领域贡献后续训练批次。我们提出DataFlex-RL，一个在统一GRPO方案下比较这些选择的评估平台。主要实验在12个匹配种子下评估13种配置，使用Qwen2.5-7B-Base和12个数学、逻辑与科学基准。均匀GRPO相较于未训练检查点，将领域平衡平均准确率提升了7.76个百分点。在八种轨迹选择或重加权方法中，没有一种在配对95%置信区间内排除零差值；在三种自适应混合方法中，也没有一种在相同精度水平上优于固定等权重混合。对Llama-3.1-8B-Base的修正12种子扩展将额外方法置于与原始对照相同的评分尺度上，但未揭示在观测均值性能上的一致胜者。我们还通过重新评分九次Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct运行，采用以数学为主的六基准摘要（包含五个数学基准和GPQA-Diamond，但无逻辑基准），并与领域平衡的12基准摘要进行比较，量化评估敏感性。结果排名呈负相关，相关系数为-0.33，而保留全部12个基准的摘要则基本一致。在本研究的受控设置中，改变数据策略会显著影响训练过程，但并未产生可重复超越均匀训练的改进。

summary: Verifiable outcome rewards guide language-model post-training, but sequence-level advantages do not identify which token-level decisions should be preserved or revised. Evidence-conditioned Teachers provide denser supervision by replaying sampled trajectories with privileged feedback. Yet indiscriminate imitation risks transferring formatting or reasoning-style shifts that do not support task success. We introduce VERPO, a Verified Evidence Regularized Policy Optimization framework that treats evidence as a proposal for policy correction while retaining the outcome objective. It separates evidence-free reference restoration from signed token-level evidence corrections. Fisher Evidence Contrast attenuates corrections along an estimated evidence-presence direction. A stopped token-wise ZPD controller scales acceptance according to local reward alignment and Fisher movement cost, while the reference channel remains independent of acceptance. Across five scientific-reasoning and tool-use tasks, the best variant on each backbone exceeds the strongest compared baseline in average score. The averages rise from 0.6826 to 0.6857 on Qwen3-4B, from 0.6895 to 0.7058 on Qwen3-8B, and from 0.4751 to 0.5657 on Llama-3.2-1B.
title: VERPO: Verified Evidence Regularized Policy Optimization
comment: 38 pages, 9 figures, including appendices
title_translated: VERPO：验证证据正则化策略优化
summary_translated: 可验证结果奖励指导语言模型后训练，但序列级优势无法识别应保留或修改的词元级决策。证据条件教师通过回放带有特权反馈的采样轨迹提供更密集的监督。然而，无差别模仿可能转移不支持任务成功的格式或推理风格变化。我们提出VERPO，一种验证证据正则化策略优化框架，将证据视为策略修正的提议，同时保留结果目标。它将无证据参考恢复与带符号的词元级证据修正分离。Fisher证据对比沿估计的证据存在方向衰减修正。停止的词元级ZPD控制器根据局部奖励对齐性和Fisher移动成本调整接受度，而参考通道保持独立于接受度。在五个科学推理和工具使用任务中，每个主干的最佳变体在平均得分上均超过最强基线。平均得分从Qwen3-4B的0.6826提升至0.6857，从Qwen3-8B的0.6895提升至0.7058，从Llama-3.2-1B的0.4751提升至0.5657。

summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of mixture-of-experts (MoE) models commonly attaches a separate low-rank adapter to each expert. This expert-wise design fragments adaptation in three ways: capacity is split across narrow low-rank updates, gradient supervision becomes sparse and imbalanced under sparse routing, and execution is decomposed into many small GEMMs. We find that such expert-wise separation is often unnecessary, as subsets of LoRA adapters become functionally similar during fine-tuning, revealing redundancy among expert-specific adapters. Based on this redundancy, we propose ACE (Adapter Consolidation across Experts), which groups redundant experts and replaces their expert-specific adapters with group-shared higher-rank LoRA modules under the same PEFT budget. ACE further introduces grouped adapter execution, which consolidates fragmented expert-wise adapter computations into fewer, larger group-level GEMMs. Across evaluations covering 12 datasets and four MoE backbones, ACE achieves the highest observed mean accuracy among the parameter-matched PEFT methods on the three backbones with complete baseline coverage, while providing $1.31\times$ to $1.48\times$ wall-clock training speedup over expert-wise LoRA without increasing peak memory. Our code is available at https://github.com/UbiquitousAILab/ACE.
title: ACE: Adapter Consolidation across Experts for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of MoE LLMs
comment: 23 pages, 13 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026
title_translated: ACE：面向MoE大模型参数高效微调的专家适配器整合
summary_translated: 混合专家（MoE）模型的参数高效微调（PEFT）通常为每个专家附加一个独立的低秩适配器。这种专家级设计在三个方面造成适应碎片化：容量被分散在狭窄的低秩更新中，稀疏路由下梯度监督变得稀疏且不平衡，执行被分解为许多小规模GEMM操作。我们发现，这种专家级分离往往并非必要，因为在微调过程中，部分LoRA适配器会变得功能相似，暴露出专家特定适配器之间的冗余。基于此冗余，我们提出ACE（专家间适配器整合），在相同PEFT预算下，将冗余专家分组，并用共享的更高秩LoRA模块替代其专家特定适配器。ACE进一步引入分组适配器执行，将碎片化的专家级适配器计算整合为更少、更大的组级GEMM。在涵盖12个数据集和四个MoE主干的评估中，ACE在三个具有完整基线覆盖的主干上，成为参数匹配PEFT方法中观察到的最高平均准确率，同时相比专家级LoRA实现1.31倍至1.48倍的墙钟训练速度提升，且未增加峰值内存。代码已发布于https://github.com/UbiquitousAILab/ACE。

summary: As vision-language models (VLMs) become increasingly capable and are deployed in consequential real-world settings, they must evaluate evidence independently rather than defer uncritically to human authority. We introduce GradeTrap, a controlled evaluation that places two social cues in direct conflict: a student answer, which should attract sycophantic agreement, and a conflicting answer attributed to a peer, teacher, or official answer key, which should attract authority-based deference. Models produce free-form answers while being explicitly instructed to solve independently and ignore all student answers, feedback, and grading marks. We test the models on 60 synthetic real-world trade-off scenarios. Five neutral trials establish a stable model-relative preference, followed by three repetitions of six experimental cues including controls. On the 45-item common intersection across Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, GPT-5.6 Luna, and Claude Haiku 4.5, a generic second-answer control yields 5.4% conflicting-answer selection. Relative to that control, pooled within-item changes show no reliable peer-review effect, a 6.9-point teacher-review effect, and a 19.5-point official-key effect. In contrast, a displayed conflicting student answer alone compared to a displayed student reference answer alone only raises selection from 2.2% to 5.2%. Official-key provenance therefore redirects judgements more than a student answer or the generic second-answer control, despite an explicit ignore instruction and an opposing student answer given along with the official key. Effects vary in magnitude across the three models.
title: GradeTrap: Authority Cues in Images Shift VLM Judgments Despite Explicit Instructions to Ignore Them
title_translated: GradeTrap：图像中的权威线索会误导VLM判断，即使明确指示忽略它们
summary_translated: 随着视觉语言模型（VLM）能力不断增强并被部署于重要现实场景中，它们必须独立评估证据，而非盲目服从人类权威。我们提出了GradeTrap，一种受控评估方法，将两种社会线索置于直接冲突之中：应引发阿谀奉承式认同的学生答案，以及来自同龄人、教师或官方答案键的矛盾答案，后者应引发基于权威的顺从。在明确指令模型独立求解并忽略所有学生答案、反馈和评分标记的前提下，模型生成自由形式的回答。我们在60个合成的真实世界权衡场景中测试了这些模型。五个中性试验建立了稳定的模型相对偏好，随后是六种实验线索（含对照组）的三轮重复。在Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite、GPT-5.6 Luna和Claude Haiku 4.5共有的45项任务中，通用的第二个答案对照组导致5.4%的选择冲突答案。相对于该对照组，合并项内变化显示：同伴评审效应不显著，教师评审效应为6.9分，官方答案键效应高达19.5分。相比之下，仅展示一个矛盾的学生答案与仅展示一个学生参考答案相比，选择率仅从2.2%上升至5.2%。因此，尽管有明确忽略指令且伴随对立学生答案，官方答案来源仍比学生答案或通用第二答案对照组更强烈地引导判断。各模型间效应幅度存在差异。

summary: Long-horizon LLM agents interact with untrusted content, persistent memory, external state, and sensitive tools. Existing analyses often characterize attacks by the number of execution steps between malicious input and a downstream action. We show that temporal remoteness can overstate security separation in stateful agents. We introduce a provenance-aware execution graph linking agent events through deterministic state, identifier, and tool provenance, and define \emph{influence distance} $\DI$ as the shortest structural path from an untrusted source to a sensitive action. We compare it with \emph{sequence distance} $\DT$, the shortest injection--sink path in the ordered trajectory. Since the influence graph contains every sequence edge, $\DI \leq \DT$; $\Gap=\DT-\DI$ measures the separation hidden by step count. Across 454 injection--sink pairs from 360 long-horizon AgentDojo trajectories over OpenAI's \texttt{gpt-4o-mini} and \texttt{gpt-4o} and Claude's Haiku 4.5 and Sonnet 4.6, $\Gap>0$ for 96.9% of pairs, with a median gap of 9 hops; 91.0% remain decoupled after removing the largest provenance-only edge class. On AgentDojo's banking suite, 33.8% of 231 pairs from 377 trajectories decouple through different provenance mechanisms. Among 274 OpenAI pairs, $\Gap$ does not independently predict attack success after controlling for $\DT$, attack family, and backend ($β_{\Gap}=0.066$, $p=.088$). At matched thresholds $k=2,3$, a deterministic $\DI$-based pre-execution gate blocks five attack sinks missed by a sequence-only gate with no additional benign blocking, although the paired gain is not significant ($p=.0625$). Execution structure therefore reveals proximity hidden by step count and can support targeted runtime intervention. We measure candidate influence pathways rather than causal attribution.
title: Structurally Close, Temporally Distant: Measuring Security Exposure in Long-Horizon LLM Agents
title_translated: 结构相近，时间遥远：长时程LLM智能体中的安全暴露度量
summary_translated: 长时程LLM智能体与不可信内容、持久记忆、外部状态及敏感工具交互。现有分析通常以恶意输入与下游动作之间的执行步骤数来刻画攻击。我们指出，时间上的远距离可能夸大状态化智能体的安全隔离程度。为此，我们引入一种溯源感知的执行图，通过确定性状态、标识符和工具溯源连接智能体事件，并定义‘影响距离’$\	ext{DI}$ 为从不可信源头到敏感动作的最短结构路径。将其与‘序列距离’$\	ext{DT}$（有序轨迹中注入-接收路径的最短距离）进行比较。由于影响图包含所有序列边，故$\	ext{DI} \leq \text{DT}$；$\	ext{Gap}=\text{DT}-\text{DI}$ 衡量了步数统计所隐藏的分离程度。在来自360条长时程AgentDojo轨迹（使用OpenAI的\texttt{gpt-4o-mini}和\texttt{gpt-4o}，以及Claude的Haiku 4.5和Sonnet 4.6）的454对注入-接收组合中，96.9%的组合存在$\	ext{Gap}>0$，中位差距为9跳；移除最大溯源独占边类后仍有91.0%保持解耦。在AgentDojo的银行套件中，377条轨迹中的231对中有33.8%通过不同溯源机制实现解耦。在274个OpenAI组合中，控制$\	ext{DT}$、攻击类型和后端后，$\	ext{Gap}$不能独立预测攻击成功（$β_{\text{Gap}}=0.066$, $p=.088$）。在匹配阈值$k=2,3$下，基于确定性$\	ext{DI}$的预执行门可拦截五个序列门遗漏的攻击目标，且无额外良性阻断，尽管配对增益不显著（$p=.0625$）。因此，执行结构揭示了步数统计所隐藏的接近性，并可支持针对性的运行时干预。我们测量候选影响路径，而非因果归因。

summary: Open-weight large language models face a low-cost white-box threat from representation engineering attacks. Attackers can estimate refusal directions and search for projection-matrix edits that suppress safety alignment while preserving general capabilities, within minutes on a single GPU and without gradient-based training. We propose Bait-and-Recover, a weight-level defense that places a bait adapter where attackers read activations and a paired recovery adapter at the subsequent layer. Trained via gradient routing, this decouples the observation path from the behavior path. By actively poisoning the residual signal used for measurement, Bait-and-Recover disrupts the attacker's edit search, while the recovery layer restores clean downstream computation. Across four open-weight models, our defense raises the minimum refusal rate against white-box edit searches from 16.25% to 71.75% under a strict behavior-preservation budget (KL <= 0.10), with negligible impact on general benchmarks. By invalidating the core measurement assumption of these attacks, observation-path poisoning offers a practical complement to behavior-level safety training.
title: Bait-and-Recover: Poisoning Internal Refusal Signals to Defend LLMs against White-Box Editing Jailbreaks

title_translated: 诱捕与恢复：通过毒化内部拒绝信号防御LLM免受白盒编辑越狱攻击
summary_translated: 开放权重的大语言模型面临低成本的白盒威胁，即表示工程攻击。攻击者可在单个GPU上几分钟内估算出拒绝方向，并搜索投影矩阵修改，以抑制安全对齐同时保留通用能力，无需基于梯度的训练。我们提出Bait-and-Recover，一种权重级防御机制，在攻击者读取激活的位置放置诱饵适配器，并在后续层设置对应的恢复适配器。通过梯度路由训练，该机制将观测路径与行为路径解耦。通过主动毒化用于测量的残差信号，Bait-and-Recover破坏了攻击者的编辑搜索过程，而恢复层则恢复干净的下游计算。在四个开放权重模型上，该防御将白盒编辑搜索下的最低拒绝率从16.25%提升至71.75%（在严格的行为保全预算下，KL ≤ 0.10），对通用基准影响极小。通过瓦解此类攻击的核心测量假设，观测路径毒化为行为级安全训练提供了实用补充。

summary: Differentially private (DP) fine-tuning methods treat sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models as a single dense block, ignoring that shared layers see all data while experts only see routed records. We identify and formally characterize three resulting failure modes: global clipping suppresses expert gradients, batch-level normalization dilutes sparse expert updates, and fixed privacy noise degrades signal-to-noise ratio on low-load experts. We introduce RAPTOR - a Role-Aware Private Training framework, which alternates shared and expert optimization and targets each failure directly, using expert-specific clipping and noise together with a public expected-owner denominator and a count-independent update schedule that avoids conditioning on private, realized expert counts. We prove the resulting mechanism satisfies $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP: because each record is assigned to exactly one owner expert, per-expert mechanisms within a layer compose in parallel, so updating all $E$ experts costs no more, in privacy terms, than updating one, with shared and expert streams composing sequentially across training. We further derive a bias-variance decomposition of the public-denominator estimator showing its bias grows predictably with routing imbalance, yielding a privacy-free rule for selecting which layer to protect from routing entropy measured on a small public corpus. Experiments on Switch Transformer and OLMoE fine-tuning across GLUE tasks, and on DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny, show consistent gains over standard DP baselines across several privacy levels ($\varepsilon$), with the largest margins typically at the tightest budgets. Code and models are publicly available: https://github.com/leduckhai/RAPTOR
title: RAPTOR: Role-Aware Private Training for Mixture-of-Experts

title_translated: RAPTOR：面向混合专家模型的角色感知私有训练
summary_translated: 差分隐私（DP）微调方法将稀疏的混合专家（MoE）模型视为单一密集块，忽略了共享层看到全部数据而专家仅处理路由记录的事实。我们识别并形式化了由此产生的三种失效模式：全局裁剪抑制专家梯度，批次级归一化稀释稀疏专家更新，固定隐私噪声降低低负载专家的信噪比。我们提出RAPTOR——一种角色感知私有训练框架，交替优化共享层与专家层，并针对每种失效模式直接应对，采用专家特定裁剪与噪声，结合公开期望拥有者分母和与计数无关的更新调度，避免依赖私有的实际专家数量。我们证明该机制满足$(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP：因为每条记录仅分配给一个拥有专家，同一层内的各专家机制并行组合，更新所有$E$个专家在隐私成本上等价于更新一个，而共享与专家流在训练过程中串行组合。我们进一步推导了公开分母估计器的偏差-方差分解，表明其偏差随路由不平衡可预测增长，从而得出一个无需隐私的规则，用于根据小规模公开语料的路由熵决定保护哪一层。在Switch Transformer和OLMoE在GLUE任务上的微调，以及DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny上的实验显示，在多个隐私水平（$\varepsilon$）下均持续优于标准DP基线，尤其在最紧预算下表现最佳。代码与模型已公开：https://github.com/leduckhai/RAPTOR

summary: Human emotion is graded and frequently mixed, yet most multimodal recognizers collapse it onto a single hard label. We argue the recognizer should instead expose a distribution over affective space. Our text+speech system, alongside its categorical decision, emits a $9\times9$ probability matrix over the Valence-Arousal plane, trained with a two-dimensional Gaussian soft target under a Kullback-Leibler/cross-entropy objective, aimed at counseling support. Evaluation is strict: speaker-independent 5-fold leave-one-session-out IEMOCAP with rotating-session inner validation, headline metrics only on the held-out session. Within one fixed encoder-fusion-head pipeline we compare Transformer and state-space (Mamba-1/2/3) backbones at matched depth and width, at two operating points ($T\approx550$, $T\approx2750$). The featured dual-head system reaches 73.0% $\pm$ 0.3 unweighted accuracy over three seeds (separate rerun: 72.1%), exceeding the Transformer fusion baseline by 3.0 UA points (95% session-bootstrap CI [1.0,4.7]; significant under paired t-test and session-level bootstrap), with no latency or memory advantage at these lengths; swapping the ~1M trainable front-end for frozen WavLM-Large features (learnable layer weights) lifts the same architecture to 76.6% $\pm$ 1.3. Pre-specified controls scope the claims honestly: simpler valence-arousal auxiliaries reproduce the classification lift within noise, and a dedicated regression head tracks the continuous ratings slightly better, so the head's specific value is the normalized affect distribution itself. That distribution recovers the circumplex: its center of mass tracks valence and arousal (CCC 0.66/0.66; predominantly between-class structure, weaker within-class tracking), and its entropy is weakly but consistently linked to categorical rater ambiguity, not dimensional spread.
title: Emotion as a Distribution: Joint Valence-Arousal Probability Learning for Speaker-Independent Multimodal Emotion Recognition

title_translated: 情绪作为分布：面向说话人无关的多模态情绪识别的联合效价-唤醒概率学习
summary_translated: 人类情绪具有连续性和混合性，但大多数多模态识别器将其简化为单一硬标签。我们认为识别器应暴露情感空间上的分布。我们的文本+语音系统在输出分类决策的同时，还生成一个覆盖效价-唤醒平面的$9\times9$概率矩阵，使用二维高斯软目标在Kullback-Leibler/交叉熵目标函数下训练，旨在支持心理咨询。评估严格：说话人无关的5折留一会话外验证，内层验证轮换会话，仅报告保留会话的主指标。在固定编码器-融合头管道中，我们对比Transformer与状态空间模型（Mamba-1/2/3）在相同深度与宽度下的表现，设定两个运行点（$T\approx550$，$T\approx2750$）。所提出的双头系统在三个种子下达到73.0% ± 0.3的未加权准确率（单独重跑：72.1%），较Transformer融合基线提升3.0 UA点（95%会话Bootstrap置信区间[1.0,4.7]；配对t检验与会话级Bootstrap均显著），在这些长度下无延迟或内存优势；将约100万可训练前端替换为冻结的WavLM-Large特征（可学习层权重）使同一架构提升至76.6% ± 1.3。预先设定的对照组诚实限定结论：更简单的效价-唤醒辅助任务在噪声范围内重现分类提升，专用回归头略好于连续评分追踪，因此头部的具体价值在于归一化的感情分布本身。该分布恢复了环形结构：其质心跟踪效价与唤醒（CCC 0.66/0.66；主要为类间结构，类内追踪较弱），其熵与分类标注者的模糊性弱但一致相关，而非维度扩展。
